articles.articleText: Akbank'tan COP31'de sürdürülebilir finans mesajı: İşletmelerin dönüşümüne destek - Akbank Genel Müdürü Kaan Gür, COP31 kapsamında düzenlenen panelde iklim dönüşümünde finans sektörünün rolüne dikkat çekti. Gür, Sürdürülebilir İklimlendirme Finansman Programı ile işletmelerin enerji verimliliği yatırımlarını ve düşük karbonlu ekonomiye geçişini desteklediklerini belirtti. Akbank Genel Müdürü Kaan Gür, COP31 kapsamında UNDP tarafından düzenlenen üst düzey panelde Türkiye’nin Ulusal Soğutma Eylem Planı’nın uygulanmasında finans sektörünün rolünü değerlendirdi. Gür, Akbank’ın Sürdürülebilir İklimlendirme Finansman Programı ile işletmelerin daha verimli sistemlere geçişini ve uluslararası kaynaklarla Türkiye’deki yatırım önceliklerinin buluşturulmasını desteklediklerini belirtti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Akbank Genel Müdürü Kaan Gür, BM İklim Değişikliği Çerçeve Sözleşmesi 31. Taraflar Konferansı (COP31) kapsamında, Birleşmiş Milletler Kalkınma Programı (UNDP) tarafından düzenlenen “Kamu-Özel Sektör İş Birliği ve Sürdürülebilir Finans Yoluyla Türkiye’nin Ulusal Soğutma Eylem Planı’nın Uygulanmasının Hızlandırılması” başlıklı panele katıldı. Moderatörlüğünü UNDP Türkiye Mukim Temsilci Yardımcısı Tomica Paović’in üstlendiği; konuşmacılar arasında T.C. Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanlığı İklim Değişikliği Başkanlığı Başkan Yardımcısı Mehrali Ecer, UNDP Türkiye İklim Değişikliği ve Çevre Portföy Yöneticisi Meral Mungan Arda, Guidehouse Direktörü Katja Eisbrenner ile İklimlendirme Soğutma Klima İmalatçıları Derneği Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Süleyman Kavas’ın da yer aldığı panelde, Türkiye’nin soğutma alanındaki önceliklerinin uygulanabilir ve ölçeklenebilir projelere dönüştürülmesi konusu ele alındı. Konuya ilişkin yaptığı açıklamada Akbank Genel Müdürü Kaan Gür, “Soğutma sistemlerinin verimliliği, emisyonların azaltılmasının yanında işletmelerin maliyetlerini ve faaliyetlerini sürdürme gücünü de doğrudan etkiliyor. Türkiye’nin Ulusal Soğutma Eylem Planı bu alanda ülkemizin yönünü ve dönüşüm stratejisini belirliyor. Önceliğimiz, plandaki hedefleri işletmelerin hayata geçirebileceği yatırımlara dönüştürmek olmalı. Bankalar, geniş müşteri ağları sayesinde öncelikli sektörleri ve yatırım ihtiyaçlarını sahada belirleyebilir; işletmelerin uygun teknolojilere ve gerekli teknik yetkinliklere erişimini destekleyebilir. Mevcut sürdürülebilir finansman ürünlerini bu yatırımlarla buluştururken, kalkınma kuruluşları ve teknoloji uzmanlarıyla iş birlikleri kurabilir. Böylece enerji tasarrufunu, emisyon azaltımını ve ekonomik getiriyi görünür hâle getirerek işletmelerin yatırım kararlarını kolaylaştırabilir ve daha verimli sistemlere geçişi hızlandırabilir. Bu doğrultuda Akbank olarak sürdürülebilir iklimlendirme yatırımlarını daha kolay belirlenen, ölçülen ve finanse edilen bir yapıya kavuşturmak için çalışıyoruz. Cool Up Programı’nın Türkiye’deki ilk finansal partneri olarak hayata geçirdiğimiz Sürdürülebilir İklimlendirme Finansman Programımızla bu süreci destekliyoruz. Amacımız, uluslararası kaynaklarla Türkiye’deki yatırım önceliklerini buluşturarak daha verimli sistemlere geçişi kolaylaştırmak ve ekonominin iklim değişikliğine karşı dayanıklılığını artırmak” dedi.

articles.titleTr: Maliyet hesabı şaşırttı: Benzin ve motorine fiyatları elektrikli araçlara talebi artırdı
articles.summaryTr: İngiltere'de benzin ve motorin fiyatlarındaki artış elektrikli otomobil satışlarını destekledi. Ancak beş farklı model üzerinden yapılan karşılaştırma, elektrikli araçların evde şarj edilse bile her zaman daha düşük maliyet sunmadığını, hızlı şarjda ise avantajın çoğunlukla kaybolduğunu gösterdi.
articles.articleText: Maliyet hesabı şaşırttı: Benzin ve motorine fiyatları elektrikli araçlara talebi artırdı - İngiltere'de benzin ve motorin fiyatlarındaki artış elektrikli otomobil satışlarını destekledi. Ancak beş farklı model üzerinden yapılan karşılaştırma, elektrikli araçların evde şarj edilse bile her zaman daha düşük maliyet sunmadığını, hızlı şarjda ise avantajın çoğunlukla kaybolduğunu gösterdi. ABD ile İran arasındaki çatışmanın etkisiyle İngiltere'de akaryakıt fiyatlarının yükselmesi, sürücülerin elektrikli otomobillere yönelmesini hızlandırdı. Ancak yeni araçlardaki indirimler ve şarj maliyetleri dikkate alındığında elektrikli otomobil tercihinin her durumda daha ekonomik olmadığı ortaya çıktı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Daily Mail'in haberine göre, İngiltere'de benzin fiyatları şubat ayına kıyasla litre başına yaklaşık 41 peni, motorin fiyatları ise 57 peni arttı. Bu artış, 55 litrelik bir deponun doldurulma maliyetini benzinli araçlarda yaklaşık 23 sterlin, dizel araçlarda 32 sterlin yükseltti. Akaryakıt maliyetlerindeki artış, elektrikli araçlara olan talebi de destekledi. Ocak-ekim döneminde yeni benzinli otomobil satışları yıllık yüzde 4,4 düşerek yaklaşık 35 bin 600 adet azalırken, dizel araç satışları yüzde 7,8 gerileyerek 83 bin 500'e indi. Tam elektrikli araç satışları yüzde 30,4, şarj edilebilir hibrit satışları ise yüzde 40 arttı. İngiliz Otomobil Birliği AA'nın Elektrikli Araçlara Hazırlık Endeksi'ne göre, elektrikli otomobile geçmeyi değerlendiren sürücülerin oranı 100 üzerinden 60'a yükseldi. Bu oran bir yıldan biraz daha uzun süre önce 47,5 seviyesindeydi. Benzinli ve dizel araçlarda indirimler azaldı Araç satışlarındaki gerilemeye rağmen bayilerin benzinli ve dizel modellerde indirimleri artırmak yerine azalttığı görüldü. Insider Car Deals verilerine göre, yeni benzinli otomobillerde ortalama indirim şubat ayındaki yüzde 10,8 seviyesinden kasımda yüzde 10,2'ye geriledi. Dizel araçlardaki indirim oranı da aynı dönemde yüzde 9,7'den yüzde 8,5'e düştü. Hibrit otomobillerde indirimler yüzde 11,3 seviyesinde sabit kalırken, elektrikli araçlardaki ortalama indirim oranı yıl başındaki yüzde 13 seviyesinden yüzde 11,1'e indi. Elektrikli araç her zaman daha ucuz değil Insider Car Deals, beş farklı araç çiftini karşılaştırarak elektrikli ve içten yanmalı motorlu modellerin aylık maliyetlerini inceledi. Hesaplamalarda yıllık 7 bin mil (yaklaşık 11 bin 265 kilometre) kullanım, araçların PCP finansman ödemeleri ve yakıt veya şarj giderleri dikkate alındı. Evde düşük tarifeli elektrikle şarj edilen araçlarda bile beş karşılaştırmanın yalnızca üçünde elektrikli model daha düşük aylık maliyet sundu. Halka açık hızlı şarj istasyonlarının kullanılması durumunda ise elektrikli araçların maliyet avantajı çoğunlukla ortadan kalktı.

articles.title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
articles.summary: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
articles.summaryTr: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.
articles.articleText: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying - Published Indonesia's Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka tendered his resignation to parliament on Thursday, triggering the process of finding his replacement amid growing turmoil for the government. Gibran had been facing impeachment calls after a Supreme Court ruling that a high-school document used during his 2024 election campaign was invalid. His departure comes amid a faltering political alliance between his father, ex-president Joko Widodo, and the incumbent President Prabowo Subianto. Standing alongside Gibran, Prabowo told reporters he had accepted his resignation with "a heavy heart". Upper house lawmakers will have 60 days to fill the vacancy from two candidates nominated by the president. "[Gibran] has demonstrated a chivalrous attitude, a strong sense of responsibility, and the qualities of a statesman," Prabowo said, adding that the resignation was "for the benefit of the nation, the state, and the people of Indonesia". "He certainly believes that he completed his education through a proper and structured process. However, we must understand that educational systems abroad differ from those in Indonesia," the president said. Gibran has long faced controversy over whether his high school qualifications met legal requirements to run for office. Having studied in Singapore and Australia, he had used an Indonesian equivalence certificate to demonstrate his educational credentials. Indonesian law requires vice-presidents to have completed senior secondary school or its equivalent, but the Supreme Court found no evidence to prove Gibran had graduated. "No evidence was found to show Gibran had a foreign diploma or certificate that could serve as the basis for equivalency with a senior high school or equivalent qualification," it said. It also considered a Constitutional Court ruling from earlier in October which came to the same conclusion. The Supreme Court ruling prompted more than 100 lawmakers to support a parliamentary initiative that could have paved the way for proceedings to impeach Gibran. Gibran previously argued that undertaking university education was sufficient proof that he had completed senior high school. On Tuesday, he asked for the chance to challenge the ruling and be given the opportunity to prove the legitimacy of his education credentials, State Secretariat Prasetyo Hadi said. Gibran's ascension to Prabowo's ticket in the 2024 election was part of an alliance formed between his father, outgoing president Joko Widodo - known as Jokowi - and Prabowo, his erstwhile bitter rival. Gibran was 36 at the time, and only became eligible for candidacy after a controversial ruling by the Constitutional Court, which exempted him from the minimum age requirement of 40. But tensions between Jokowi and Prabowo appear to have flared. Since taking the presidency, Prabowo has shown little interest in pushing ahead with Jokowi's legacy project: the construction of Nusantara, a new capital. Instead, he has focused much of the state's resources on his own flagship programme to provide free school meals across the country. In a series of personnel reshuffles over the past year, Prabowo has also shifted many Jokowi loyalists into new roles, including long-serving finance minister Sri Mulyani Indrawati. Last week, authorities arrested several senior officials, including presidential chief of staff Listyo Sigit Prabowo - no relation to Prabowo - on suspicions of wiretapping the president. Prabowo sacked Listyo a day later, in what many pointed to as a sign of a crumbling alliance: Listyo, who formerly served as the national police chief, is widely considered a long-time ally of Jokowi. Within the government, allegiances seem to be shifting. On Monday, three members of Prabowo's cabinet collectively resigned from the party led by Kaesang Pangarep, Jokowi's youngest son, citing their desire to focus on their duties in Prabowo's administration. But neither man has confirmed the rift. Speaking to reporters on Thursday, Jokowi said he still supported Prabowo's leadership. Jokowi also said Gibran's resignation was part of "political dynamics" and he had told his son "the position was temporary". All this is unfolding at a particularly turbulent period in Prabowo's presidency. The free school meals programme is struggling for funding, parts of Indonesia have recently battled the country's worst wildfires in a decade, and the national stock market faces crisis amid allegations of widespread market manipulation. Across the country, students and activists have staged demonstrations to protest against the government's handling of a range of issues, including the environmental crisis and corruption. "[Gibran] has demonstrated a chivalrous attitude, a strong sense of responsibility, and the qualities of a statesman," Prabowo said, adding that the resignation was "for the benefit of the nation, the state, and the people of Indonesia". "He certainly believes that he completed his education through a proper and structured process. However, we must understand that educational systems abroad differ from those in Indonesia," the president said. Gibran has long faced controversy over whether his high school qualifications met legal requirements to run for office. Having studied in Singapore and Australia, he had used an Indonesian equivalence certificate to demonstrate his educational credentials. Indonesian law requires vice-presidents to have completed senior secondary school or its equivalent, but the Supreme Court found no evidence to prove Gibran had graduated. "No evidence was found to show Gibran had a foreign diploma or certificate that could serve as the basis for equivalency with a senior high school or equivalent qualification," it said. It also considered a Constitutional Court ruling from earlier in October which came to the same conclusion. The Supreme Court ruling prompted more than 100 lawmakers to support a parliamentary initiative that could have paved the way for proceedings to impeach Gibran. Gibran previously argued that undertaking university education was sufficient proof that he had completed senior high school. On Tuesday, he asked for the chance to challenge the ruling and be given the opportunity to prove the legitimacy of his education credentials, State Secretariat Prasetyo Hadi said. Gibran's ascension to Prabowo's ticket in the 2024 election was part of an alliance formed between his father, outgoing president Joko Widodo - known as Jokowi - and Prabowo, his erstwhile bitter rival. Gibran was 36 at the time, and only became eligible for candidacy after a controversial ruling by the Constitutional Court, which exempted him from the minimum age requirement of 40. But tensions between Jokowi and Prabowo appear to have flared. Since taking the presidency, Prabowo has shown little interest in pushing ahead with Jokowi's legacy project: the construction of Nusantara, a new capital. Instead, he has focused much of the state's resources on his own flagship programme to provide free school meals across the country. In a series of personnel reshuffles over the past year, Prabowo has also shifted many Jokowi loyalists into new roles, including long-serving finance minister Sri Mulyani Indrawati. Last week, authorities arrested several senior officials, including presidential chief of staff Listyo Sigit Prabowo - no relation to Prabowo - on suspicions of wiretapping the president. Prabowo sacked Listyo a day later, in what many pointed to as a sign of a crumbling alliance: Listyo, who formerly served as the national police chief, is widely considered a long-time ally of Jokowi. Within the government, allegiances seem to be shifting. On Monday, three members of Prabowo's cabinet collectively resigned from the party led by Kaesang Pangarep, Jokowi's youngest son, citing their desire to focus on their duties in Prabowo's administration. But neither man has confirmed the rift. Speaking to reporters on Thursday, Jokowi said he still supported Prabowo's leadership. Jokowi also said Gibran's resignation was part of "political dynamics" and he had told his son "the position was temporary". All this is unfolding at a particularly turbulent period in Prabowo's presidency. The free school meals programme is struggling for funding, parts of Indonesia have recently battled the country's worst wildfires in a decade, and the national stock market faces crisis amid allegations of widespread market manipulation. Across the country, students and activists have staged demonstrations to protest against the government's handling of a range of issues, including the environmental crisis and corruption. articles.titleTr: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $2B over nine sessions
articles.summaryTr: US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows rose to nearly $300 million on Wednesday, up from $95 million a day earlier, as five-session withdrawals reached $1.44 billion.
articles.articleText: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $2B over nine sessions US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows rose to nearly $300 million on Wednesday, up from $95 million a day earlier, as five-session withdrawals reached $1.44 billion. BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF), the iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT), recorded more than $2 billion in net outflows over nine consecutive trading sessions through Wednesday. Investors pulled a net $269.7 million from IBIT on Wednesday, accounting for about 90% of the day’s $300 million in net withdrawals across US spot Bitcoin ETFs, according to Farside Investors data. Grayscale’s Bitcoin Trust ETF (GBTC) recorded $39.1 million in net withdrawals, while the Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust ETF (MSBT) drew $9 million in net inflows. US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted nearly $1.44 billion in net withdrawals over five straight sessions. Wednesday’s increase followed three sessions of easing outflows. Crypto exchange Bitfinex said on Wednesday that slowing ETF outflows could be an early step toward a market floor, but were not enough on their own to establish a recovery. Bitfinex found that in the ETF outflow streaks it studied earlier this year, Bitcoin gained a median 6.4% over 10 trading sessions when the streaks ended with at least three consecutive sessions of net inflows. Bitcoin traded near $73,000 at the time of writing, down 8.5% over the past week, according to CoinGecko. In a Wednesday note shared with Cointelegraph, Laser Digital’s derivatives trading desk pointed to weak spot demand, a persistently negative Coinbase premium and large liquidations of leveraged long positions. The desk said Bitcoin barely rose during Monday’s rebound in the Nasdaq, which gained almost 3%. Related: Bitcoin hovers near $74K as stocks rise despite US bond yield rebound

articles.title: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning
articles.summary: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning
articles.summaryTr: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.
articles.articleText: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning - Published Ugandan police are investigating the deaths of four pupils at a school in the capital Kampala which they suspect may be the result of poisoning. The four girls, aged between nine and 11 years, died on Tuesday. Three of the pupils died at home while the fourth passed away while receiving emergency treatment at a hospital. The head teacher at the school, Ta'aliim Primary School and Quran Memorisation Centre, has been arrested to assist with investigations. According to the school, eight pupils had eaten oranges shared by a fellow pupil. Five pupils, including the four who later died, started vomiting. The fifth is still in hospital. Post-mortem examinations are being carried out to determine the exact cause of death. A police spokesperson was quoted by local media as saying that detectives would visit the village where the oranges the pupils ate came from. The centre has been cordoned off as a crime scene. Ugandan media shared videos of grieving parents describing their children's final moments, with some accusing the school of failing to provide clear and timely information. The police have offered condolences to the bereaved families and affected community and say more information will be provided in due course. The tragedy comes at a time when concerns are mounting over health and safety conditions in schools across Uganda. Previous cases involving suspected contaminated food and exposure to harmful substances have left pupils hospitalised with symptoms including stomach pain, vomiting and breathing difficulties. The incidents have intensified calls for authorities to strengthen monitoring of school feeding schemes, improve hygiene standards and ensure safer learning environments for children. articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
articles.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, Binance’s chief security officer described a fake job interview attack months before hackers used a similar tactic in the exchange’s $6.3 billion breach; OKX and NYSE parent ICE prepared to launch tokenized stock trading despite objections from dozens of major companies, and Barclays increased its holdings in BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin ETF by 48% in the third quarter. Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack Months before Binance lost $6.3 billion to a hack, its chief security officer described to Cointelegraph how a fake job interview could give attackers a foothold inside the exchange — closely resembling one of the entry methods later used against the exchange. During a July interview about Binance’s response to rising security threats, Jimmy Su told Cointelegraph that fake job interviews were “something we worry about a lot internally,” explaining how attackers could tailor a job opportunity to an employee before persuading them to run code as part of a technical assessment. “And once that gets executed, the device is compromised and then they can start harvesting credentials,” Su said, adding that attackers could then use that to penetrate further into the network. Su’s detailed warning about malicious coding assessments was not included in Cointelegraph’s July coverage, but takes on new significance following the biggest crypto exchange hack in history. OKXICE moves ahead with tokenized stocks as blue chips push back Crypto exchange OKX and New York Stock Exchange parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) are set to launch tokenized stock trading on Nov. 23, despite objections from 67 companies to having their shares listed and warnings from Nasdaq that trading across disconnected platforms could fragment liquidity. The venture, known as OKXICE, will operate under the US Securities and Exchange Commission’s temporary Innovation Exemption and offer eligible US customers round-the-clock trading. Under the exemption, venues must give companies a chance to object before listing shares tokenized by an unaffiliated third party. JPMorgan Chase, McDonald’s, SpaceX and Coca-Cola were among the companies that objected. Tokenized stocks are blockchain-based tokens that represent company shares or track their price. The rights they carry depend on how they are structured. The distributed value of tokenized stocks and ETFs reached $3.88 billion on Nov. 11, up 13.4% over 30 days. In comments to Cointelegraph, former New York governor and OKXICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo said investors would have “the same rights, protections and ownership that come with the underlying shares.” Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings Barclays reported holding 3.94 million shares in BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF) at the end of the third quarter, up 48% from the previous quarter. The position in the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) was worth about $187 million on Sept. 30, up from $88.5 million for 2.66 million shares on June 30, according to Barclays’ Friday Form 13F filing. “Early readings suggest longer-term holders make up a growing share of the spot bitcoin ETF investor base,” Bitwise analyst Camran Khosravi told Cointelegraph, pointing to increased bank exposure, including at Citigroup. Citigroup reported a new position worth about $119 million in the Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC). Its reported IBIT holdings also rose 50% to about 521,000 shares, from 347,000 at the end of June. The filings offer an early indication of changing institutional Bitcoin ETF ownership, with more major banks and hedge funds yet to disclose their third-quarter positions. Institutional investment managers have until Monday to file their third-quarter holdings reports.

articles.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

articles.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

news.summary: A dangerous search for survivors continues after a three-storey building collapsed in Brooklyn on Wednesday afternoon.

news.titleTr: New York building collapse kills at least two, officials say
news.summaryTr: A dangerous search for survivors continues after a three-storey building collapsed in Brooklyn on Wednesday afternoon.
news.articleText: New York building collapse kills at least two, officials say - Published At least two people have died and more than 17 others are injured after a building in New York City collapsed into an open construction site, officials have said. The collapse sparked a massive search-and-rescue operation, with more than 250 first responders going to the scene of the fallen three-storey building in Brooklyn. Aerial footage has shown firefighters pulling a survivor, covered in dust, out of the debris on a stretcher. She was later said to have been a pregnant woman. US media reports suggest the death toll is rising and officials say they do not know how many others are missing. An investigation is under way into what caused Wednesday afternoon's sudden collapse. Witnesses described a terrifying sound as the building came down at about 16:00 local time (21:00 GMT). "I live literally right behind the building," one woman, Emmanuella Carilus, told the New York Times. "It sounded like a big boom and you just heard a bunch of screaming." The newspaper published images showing a crowd of fire trucks and police vehicles at the same, and wrote that the noise of sirens had not stopped in the area. "I've never seen anything like this," said another witness, named only as Dashik, who spoke to local television station PIX 11. Officials are yet to identify those who died or were injured. Locals have gathered at the scene to await news of those feared to have been caught in the collapse. The rescue mission has been described as "extremely dangerous" by New York City Fire Department (FDNY) Commissioner Lillian Bonsignore. She added that people from the collapsed building and also the construction site had been trapped. "Members have been working methodically and haven't stopped since they arrived this afternoon," Bonsignore said. The woman who was filmed being rescued from the rubble was identified by her husband. news.titleTr: Who could replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia's chief executive?
news.summaryTr: As uncertainty swirls over the boss of the AI chip giant, some names have emerged as potential successors.
news.articleText: Who could replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia's chief executive? - Published Nvidia is facing a scenario few would have considered until very recently - a future without Jensen Huang. The chief executive and co-founder of the AI chip-making giant is at the centre of a major scandal over reports of extramarital affairs, one of which was with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. Nvidia's board is reportedly meeting to discuss whether to replace Huang. But finding the right person to lead the business that Huang helped create more than three decades ago and turned into the world's second most valuable company - after Apple - is a challenge. We take a look at which candidates have emerged as potential successors. The finance chief Colette Kress, Nvidia's chief financial officer, has been tipped as someone who could steady the ship in the interim, and possibly stop its share price from plunging even further. An industry veteran for more than 30 years, Kress previously held high positions at tech firms like Cisco and Microsoft. Kress, who also serves as Nvidia's executive vice president, has seen the firm's transformation from making chips for video games in the early 1990s to becoming an AI semiconductor powerhouse. She "fronts every earnings call" alongside Huang and is a "familiar and trusted voice for the market at a time when it badly needs one," said Josh Gilbert, an analyst at investment firm eToro. But doing the job permanently could be a different story, said Gilbert, as the firm, known for its edge in technology, could want an engineer in the chair. The co-founder and the engineer Another option is Chris Malachowsky, who founded Nvidia alongside Huang and Curtis Priem, and is the only executive that shares the same level of seniority. Malachowsky has played a key part in developing the company's computing technology. Ian Buck, who oversees Nvidia's high-performance computing business, has also emerged as a potential candidate if the company is keen to put an engineer in the top job. Buck was among the early pioneers who helped popularise the use of graphic processors beyond gaming applications. "He could protect Nvidia's technological edge, but his ability to manage the wider commercial relationships and geopolitical challenges would face scrutiny," said Charu Chanana, investment strategist at investment bank Saxo. Today, Nvidia's leading processors are widely regarded as the gold standard for AI development. Huang's children also work at Nvidia in executive positions but are relatively young and inexperienced. Apple and Arm's top brass Nvidia is likely to favour an internal appointment initially but could look externally for a more permanent replacement, said Jun Bei Liu, founder and lead portfolio manager at Ten Cap. Several names of tech entrepreneurs outside of Nvidia have been floated by experts. Liu said Apple's former chief executive, Tim Cook, could be a possible choice as someone familiar with managing global supply chains, though she questioned whether he would be willing to leave the iPhone maker, where he is the chair. Liu and Chanana also suggested Rene Haas, chief executive of Arm Holdings, the UK chipmaking giant. Nvidia's processors are made with the help of chipmakers around the world, including Taiwan's TSMC and South Korea's SK Hynix and Samsung. Haas is familiar with leading a publicly-listed company and would bring semiconductor experience, though Nvidia's business model is considerably different from Arm's, said Chanana. "The challenge is finding someone who can combine Jensen's technical understanding, strategic vision and relationships across the global technology industry," Liu said. Where now for Huang? Ten Cap's Liu believes it is a matter of time in terms of Huang stepping down as Nvidia's chief executive. "The issue is no longer simply about personal conduct," she said. "It is about corporate governance, national security concerns and maintaining confidence in the leadership of one of the world's most strategically important companies." Several major investment firms have downgraded their forecasts for the chip giant - a rare shift given investors' longstanding optimism about the company. Stacy Rasgon, senior analyst in US semiconductors at Bernstein Research, wrote in a note to investors that "our gut tells us we probably haven't fully probed the depths of what might be found here". Rasgon halved Bernstein's share price target for Nvidia and said: "We've had enough and prefer to watch from the sidelines." Ray Wang, chief executive of Constellation Research, said the crisis isn't so much an issue for the wider AI industry but rather one for Nvidia itself which has to consider if the person it appoints as its chief executive has the same appeal as Huang. "That's really what the issue is, because a lot of these partnerships and investments have been made because of the trust with with Jensen," he said. news.title: UK economy grows at fastest rate for more than two years
news.summary: ﻿The UK economy grew by 0.7% in the three months to September, according to official figures.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: UK economy grows at fastest rate for more than two years
news.summaryTr: ﻿The UK economy grew by 0.7% in the three months to September, according to official figures.
news.articleText: UK economy grows at fastest rate for more than two years - Published The UK economy grew at its fastest rate for more than two years in the three months to September. Between July and September, the economy expanded by 0.7%, accelerating from the previous three months, official figures, external show. The robust growth suggests a far more resilient economy than expected over the summer, despite the impact of higher energy prices from the Iran war. Strong growth in the services sector - the largest part of the economy, which includes non-physical goods such as consultancy services and computer programming as well as hotels and restaurants - helped boost the numbers. Within services, computer programming registered its fastest growth for the past three years, helped by cloud computing and AI-linked spending. The boost from computer programming and consultancy services has been the biggest driver of growth so far this year. Grant Fitzner, chief economist at the Office for National Statistics, said it was "possible growth could have been even stronger" if there hadn't been a war in the Middle East. But he says households may still not feel better off, and that prices might soon start to rise more quickly than wages. However, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said the figures were "welcome news". "Despite a year where events around the world have pushed up costs here at home, our economy is growing, bringing hope for the future," he said. Chancellor John Healey told the BBC the figures showed a "remarkable resilience" in the face of global conflicts, and hopes they "bring back confidence in Britain". Asked about how government decisions could be the reason for growth when AI investment has been a main driver, Healey said ministers can always "help or hinder" business confidence and investments. Although investors have recently been concerned about slower artificial intelligence development in the US and the long term viability of AI firms' business models, businesses have continued to invest in the technologies. Sarah Coles, from investment platform AJ Bell, said that since the start of the year, "it's the less visible back-office work that has delivered, with administrative and supportive services seeing strong growth" noting that these are the areas benefitting from the increasing use of AI. The latest figures put the UK on course to be the second fastest growing economy across the major G7 countries which also includes Canada, Japan, Germany, Italy and France. However, Jake Finney, senior economist at consultancy PwC, cautioned that growth was likely to slow over the coming months "unless energy markets stabilise". A sharp rise in energy bills is forecast for January, which is likely to hit consumer spending and confidence, he said. High energy costs have been stoked by the ongoing conflict in the Middle East and Russia's invasion of Ukraine. US and Israeli attacks led to Iran blocking the Strait of Hormuz - a vital shipping route for the world's oil and gas. Meanwhile, Russia and Ukraine have been attacking each other's oil refineries, leading to a squeeze on global refining capacity, hitting diesel and petrol prices. - What's happening to the UK economy and how does it affect you? - Published1 hour ago 'Surprising resilience' Richard Benc, founder of mechanical watch company Studio Underdog, says sales are better than he expected. "We've seen more resilience than we had forecast for and expected. We are still projecting growth this year," he says. The business exports about 80% of its watches. "We've seen a surprising amount of resilience, particularly from our US customers," he adds, although some UK customers are now taking longer to buy watches. news.title: 2024'te 1 milyon dolara alınmıştı: Efsanefi gemi batırıldı
news.summary: ABD'nin tarihi yolcu gemilerinden SS United States, Florida açıklarında yapay resif oluşturulması amacıyla batırıldı. Gemi, Okaloosa County yönetimi tarafından 2024'te SS United States Conservancy kuruluşundan yaklaşık 1 milyon dolara satın alınmıştı.

news.titleTr: 2024'te 1 milyon dolara alınmıştı: Efsanefi gemi batırıldı
news.summaryTr: ABD'nin tarihi yolcu gemilerinden SS United States, Florida açıklarında yapay resif oluşturulması amacıyla batırıldı. Gemi, Okaloosa County yönetimi tarafından 2024'te SS United States Conservancy kuruluşundan yaklaşık 1 milyon dolara satın alınmıştı.
news.articleText: 2024'te 1 milyon dolara alınmıştı: Efsanefi gemi batırıldı - ABD'nin tarihi yolcu gemilerinden SS United States, Florida açıklarında yapay resif oluşturulması amacıyla batırıldı. ABD'nin bir dönem transatlantik hız rekorunu elinde bulunduran yolcu gemisi SS United States, Florida eyaletinin Meksika Körfezi kıyılarında kontrollü operasyonla batırılarak dünyanın en büyük yapay resifine dönüştürüldü. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle CBS News'ün haberine göre, Titanik'ten daha büyük ve yaklaşık 305 metre uzunluğundaki gemi, Florida'nın Destin-Fort Walton Beach bölgesi ile Pensacola kenti arasında, kıyıdan yaklaşık 20 deniz mili açıkta dün batırıldı. Saatler süren batırma operasyonu, patlayıcı kullanılmadan yapıldı. Batırılan geminin, Meksika Körfezi'ndeki deniz canlıları için yeni bir yaşam alanı oluşturması hedefleniyor. İlk seferini 1952'de yapan SS United States, hizmete girdiği dönemde bir yolcu gemisinin Atlantik Okyanusu'nu en hızlı geçme rekorunu kırdı. Bugüne kadar kırılamayan rekoruyla denizcilik tarihine geçen geminin yolcuları arasında devlet başkanları, kraliyet ailesi mensupları ve ünlüler yer aldı. 1969'da hizmet dışı bırakılan gemi, 1996'da Philadelphia'ya demirledi. Florida'daki Okaloosa County yönetimi, gemiyi yapay resife dönüştürmek amacıyla 2024'te SS United States Conservancy kuruluşundan yaklaşık 1 milyon dolara satın almıştı.

news.titleTr: Cevdet Yılmaz'dan COP31'de iklim finansmanı mesajı: Yatırımlar öne çıkmalı
news.summaryTr: Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Cevdet Yılmaz, COP31'de iklim hedeflerinin kalkınma öncelikleriyle uyumlu olması gerektiğini belirterek, iklim mücadelesinde taahhütlerden somut yatırımlara geçilmesi ve finansmana erişimin kolaylaştırılması çağrısı yaptı.
news.articleText: Cevdet Yılmaz'dan COP31'de iklim finansmanı mesajı: Yatırımlar öne çıkmalı - Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Cevdet Yılmaz, COP31'de iklim hedeflerinin kalkınma öncelikleriyle uyumlu olması gerektiğini belirterek, iklim mücadelesinde taahhütlerden somut yatırımlara geçilmesi ve finansmana erişimin kolaylaştırılması çağrısı yaptı. Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Cevdet Yılmaz, "Türkiye olarak, iklim hedefleriyle kalkınma önceliklerinin birbirini desteklemesi gerektiğine inanıyoruz. Ülkelerin kendi ihtiyaçlarına göre şekillenen çözümlerin, uluslararası ortaklıklarla desteklenmesi esas olmalıdır" dedi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Yılmaz, Antalya'da düzenlenen Birleşmiş Milletler (BM) İklim Değişikliği Çerçeve Sözleşmesi 31. Taraflar Konferansı (COP31) kapsamında Kapadokya Salonu'nda düzenlenen "Paris Anlaşması'nın İkinci On Yılı: Uygulama ve Finansman" oturumunda yaptığı konuşmada, Paris Anlaşması'nın ilk on yılında, küresel iklim mücadelesinin ortak hedeflerini ve kurumsal temellerini oluşturduklarını söyledi. İkinci on yıldaki temel görevin, bu hedefleri ekonomik ve toplumsal hayatta somut sonuçlara dönüştürmek olduğunu belirten Yılmaz, tarafların yeni iklim beyanlarının, genişleyen bir ortak iradeye işaret ettiğini anlattı. Yılmaz, mevcut hedeflerin tam olarak gerçekleştirilmesi halinde bile 2035 yılına yönelik küresel emisyon düşüşünün sınırlı kalmasının, daha güçlü ve hızlı uygulamaya duyulan ihtiyacı ortaya koyduğunu vurgulayarak, "Artık başarımızı yalnızca açıklanan taahhütlerle değil, hayata geçen yatırımlarla, güçlenen dayanıklılıkla ve insanların yaşamlarında sağlanan iyileşmelerle değerlendirmeliyiz. Bu doğrultudaki temel girişimlerimizden biri, İklim Uygulama Köprüsü'dür (BRIDGE). BRIDGE vasıtasıyla amacımız, ülkelerin ulusal iklim planlarını yatırıma hazır projelere dönüştürmelerine destek olmak ve bu projeleri kamu ile özel finansman kaynaklarıyla buluşturmaktır" değerlendirmesini yaptı. Ülkelerin Ulusal Katkı Beyanları, Ulusal Uyum Planları ve uzun vadeli düşük emisyonlu kalkınma stratejilerinin dönüşüm için önemli bir yol haritası sunduğunu dile getiren Yılmaz, şöyle konuştu: "Ancak bunların uygulanması, finansmana erişimin kolaylaştırılmasını ve ulusal kapasitenin güçlendirilmesini gerektiriyor. Özellikle gelişmekte olan ülkeler, yüksek finansman maliyetleri, proje hazırlama güçlükleri ve teknik kapasite eksiklikleri nedeniyle ihtiyaç duydukları yatırımları gerçekleştirmekte zorlanıyor. Finansman yalnızca miktar meselesi değildir. Kaynağın doğru zamanda, uygun koşullarla, özellikle dönüşüm maliyetinin yüksek olduğu ülkelere ve sektörlere ulaşması gerekir. İklim yatırımlarını kalkınma hedeflerinden ayrı düşünemeyiz" "Yeni Kolektif Sayısallaştırılmış İklim Finansmanı Hedefi (NCQG) kapsamında ortaya konulan finansman iradesinin, ülkelerin sahadaki ihtiyaçlarına karşılık vermesi önemlidir. Kamu kaynaklarını özel yatırımları harekete geçirecek şekilde kullanmak ortak sorumluluğumuzdur. Türkiye olarak, iklim hedefleriyle kalkınma önceliklerinin birbirini desteklemesi gerektiğine inanıyoruz. Ülkelerin kendi ihtiyaçlarına göre şekillenen çözümlerin, uluslararası ortaklıklarla desteklenmesi esas olmalıdır. Bu nedenle kamunun görevi, yatırım ortamını güçlendirmek ve riskleri azaltmak, uluslararası kuruluşların görevi, ülkelerin ihtiyaçlarına uygun ortaklıklar geliştirmek, özel sektörün görevi ise teknolojiyi, yenilikçiliği ve yatırımları sahaya taşımaktır" "Sonuçlara dönüştüğü bir dönem haline getirelim" Cevdet Yılmaz, adil bir uygulama sürecinin, ülkelerin farklı başlangıç noktalarını dikkate alması gerektiğinin altını çizerek, bu kapsamda en az gelişmiş ülkelerin yeşil sanayileşmesini destekleyen LDC-GIF ve şehirlerin iklim direncine yönelik SURFF gibi girişimlerin, finansmana erişimi somut projelerle buluşturmasını önemsediklerini ifade etti. news.title: Tron and Tether bring in Chainalysis after T3 crime unit folds
news.summary: The group will focus on illicit USDT activity on Tron and help law enforcement investigate suspicious transfers and freeze funds faster.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Tron and Tether bring in Chainalysis after T3 crime unit folds
news.summaryTr: The group will focus on illicit USDT activity on Tron and help law enforcement investigate suspicious transfers and freeze funds faster.
news.articleText: Tron and Tether bring in Chainalysis after T3 crime unit folds The group will focus on illicit USDT activity on Tron and help law enforcement investigate suspicious transfers and freeze funds faster. Tron, Tether and Chainalysis announced a task force Thursday to identify and disrupt illicit activity involving USDT (USDT) stablecoin on the Tron blockchain. The Digital Crime Task Force will use blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis’ data and AI tools to flag suspicious activity and give law enforcement leads to trace and freeze funds, according to an announcement shared with Cointelegraph. Bloomberg reported on Nov. 4 that the T3 Financial Crime Unit, which Tron and Tether formed with TRM Labs in 2024, disbanded in late August. An unnamed source cited by the outlet said slow responses and poor coordination hampered the unit. Cointelegraph contacted Tether, Tron and TRM Labs for comment but did not receive responses by publication time. Related: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack The task force’s priorities include investment and romance scams, crypto theft, terrorist financing, North Korean cyber operations and cartel money laundering. “Criminals are using AI to move faster than ever, and waiting for a victim to report a crime is no longer good enough,” Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino said in the announcement. He put Tether’s cumulative USDT freezes at more than $7 billion. How criminal networks use USDT on Tron USDT on Tron accounted for 99.9% of the $1.07 billion in crypto received by 34 casinos in Sihanoukville, a Cambodian city known as a hub for scam compounds, from Jan. 1 to Sept. 7, TRM Labs reported. Casinos tied to US-sanctioned networks received $687 million of those inflows. TRM Labs cited low fees and deep liquidity as reasons for the widespread use of USDT on Tron in the region. Following the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in February 2025, stolen funds were converted to USDT on Tron and cashed out through suspected Chinese over-the-counter trading services, according to blockchain intelligence company Elliptic. During the record $6.3 billion Binance hack on Oct. 29, hackers swapped approximately $234 million in USDT for Tron’s native token (TRX) before Tether froze the remaining USDT in two wallets linked to the theft, according to Crystal Intelligence. The US Federal Bureau of Investigation attributed both hacks to North Korea. In a statement published by North Korean state media on Nov. 3, Kim Yo Jong rejected the Binance attribution and cited Bybit as another case in which she said Washington tried to blame Pyongyang. news.title: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
news.summary: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
news.summaryTr: The proposed radical overhaul of the welfare system would move under-25s off the main sickness benefits.
news.articleText: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say - Published Some young people could see reductions to the benefits they are entitled to under a radical overhaul of the welfare system to be recommended by a government-commissioned review. As reported in the Times,, external Alan Milburn's year-long report, to be published on Tuesday, is expected to recommend moving under-25s off the main sickness and disability benefits. Milburn, a former Labour health secretary, has been tasked by the government with helping reduce the one in eight 16 to 24 year-olds in the UK who are not in education, employment or training - otherwise known as "Neet". He said on Wednesday night that his plans would not be "pain-free" and would affect both existing and new claimants. His report is expected to say that under-25s should no longer be able to claim the health element of universal credit or personal independence payment (Pip). Instead, they would receive an allowance on the same basic rate as universal credit. Some could be eligible for a new "additional cost allowance" to cover day-to-day costs related to their conditions. Some claimants would receive less under the plans - although the exact amounts will not be clear until early next year, when the government publishes legislation to implement the changes. People can claim Pip to help them with the additional cost of being disabled or living with long-term physical or mental health conditions. It is available to those both in and out of work. Of the four million people claiming Pip in England and Wales, around 430,000 are aged between 16 and 24. In his interim report,, external Milburn said survey data found that 19% of young people claiming disability or health benefits were in work. Milburn, a Labour MP from 1992 to 2010, is also expected to recommend an investment of billions into more employment support for young people, including work placements, job subsidies and one-to-one personal advisers. Those with more severe disabilities and unable to work would get a new benefit paid at a higher rate. Milburn told the Times about his report: "Candidly, it could mean that some people will get less financial support at the beginning of their benefit claim than under the current system. "But actually, for young people, there's a different debate that we've got to resolve, which is whether the priority is their longer-term life chances or just their immediate shorter-term finances. "I think what the current system does [is] it prioritises the latter over the former. I believe that's the wrong choice and it needs to be the other way around." Just under one million young people in the UK are Neets, data from the Office for National Statistics (ONS) from April to June suggests. This was a rise of 3% on the same period last year. Milburn's recommendations are likely to be backed by Prime Minister Andy Burnham but could prove controversial among Labour MPs, who opposed welfare changes last year under his predecessor Sir Keir Starmer. Labour backbencher Bell Ribeiro-Addy said she was "not sure" she could vote to cut the benefit entitlement of existing claimants, adding that opposition to this idea had been a factor in last year's welfare rebellion. She told BBC Radio 4's Today programme: "I don't think you get a disabled young person into work by taking away the money that helps them get into work," she added. Asked about her comments, Housing Minister Matthew Pennycook said: "I think in principle it would be wrong to just set aside the almost a million young people who are not earning or learning and to say we're content for them to continue to struggle within a status quo that isn't working and only look to the future." In his Times interview, Milburn acknowledged that changing the rules for existing claimants would be "difficult politically" but added that it was necessary. Disability groups welcomed extra employment support, but expressed concern that disabled young people could lose out. A government spokesperson said: "We will always ensure there is a safety net for the most vulnerable and those who are unable to work." The reforms would represent a radical overhaul of Britain's welfare system, at a time when there is heavy political pressure for the UK to find the money to spend more on defence. Both the Conservatives and Reform UK have argued for significant cuts to welfare, including to fund a boost to defence. If Milburn's recommendations were approved, it could take almost a decade for the British state to see monetary savings. The new system "will need significant investment" and would involve "rebuilding the system from scratch", Milburn said. His new proposed system would involve an element of carrot and stick, wherein young people could lose some of their benefits if they did not engage with the extra work support options. A separate review - co-chaired by disabilities minister Sir Stephen Timms - examining disabilities benefits is also expected to be published this month. news.titleTr: Ethlabs drops Hegotá slot proposal in push for 2027 quantum readiness
news.summaryTr: Ethlabs’ roadmap aims to help Ethereum withstand quantum attacks and give users a way to protect their accounts by 2027.
news.articleText: Ethlabs drops Hegotá slot proposal in push for 2027 quantum readiness Ethlabs’ roadmap aims to help Ethereum withstand quantum attacks and give users a way to protect their accounts by 2027. Ethereum research group Ethlabs said Wednesday it will withdraw its proposal to speed up the network’s block production from the planned Hegotá upgrade, urging core developers to prepare the network for quantum attacks by 2027. On Wednesday, the group outlined “pqai27,” a proposed roadmap that aims to protect Ethereum against threats from quantum computing and increasingly capable artificial intelligence. It said unrelated upgrades should be reconsidered. Ethlabs previously backed Ethereum Improvement Proposal (EIP)-8198, known as Quick Slots, which would initially cut Ethereum’s slot time from 12 seconds to 10 seconds. The group said it would redirect resources to pqai27 but will still pursue faster slots in 2028. For Hegotá, Ethlabs said FOCIL, a planned censorship-resistance feature, should proceed only if it does not jeopardize quantum readiness. The group called Frame Transactions, which would enable more flexible account authentication, central to the proposed transition. It said Glamsterdam, the upgrade before Hegotá, should proceed as planned. Ethereum core developers have not approved the proposal. The Ethereum Foundation’s published roadmap still targets December 2029 for quantum resistance. At Devcon, researcher Justin Drake said he hopes to complete the transition in 2028. news.articleTextTr: Ethlabs drops Hegotá slot proposal in push for 2027 quantum readiness Ethlabs’ roadmap aims to help Ethereum withstand quantum attacks and give users a way to protect their accounts by 2027. Ethereum research group Ethlabs said Wednesday it will withdraw its proposal to speed up the network’s block production from the planned Hegotá upgrade, urging core developers to prepare the network for quantum attacks by 2027. On Wednesday, the group outlined “pqai27,” a proposed roadmap that aims to protect Ethereum against threats from quantum computing and increasingly capable artificial intelligence. It said unrelated upgrades should be reconsidered. Ethlabs previously backed Ethereum Improvement Proposal (EIP)-8198, known as Quick Slots, which would initially cut Ethereum’s slot time from 12 seconds to 10 seconds. The group said it would redirect resources to pqai27 but will still pursue faster slots in 2028. For Hegotá, Ethlabs said FOCIL, a planned censorship-resistance feature, should proceed only if it does not jeopardize quantum readiness. The group called Frame Transactions, which would enable more flexible account authentication, central to the proposed transition. It said Glamsterdam, the upgrade before Hegotá, should proceed as planned. Ethereum core developers have not approved the proposal. The Ethereum Foundation’s published roadmap still targets December 2029 for quantum resistance. At Devcon, researcher Justin Drake said he hopes to complete the transition in 2028. news.summaryTr: ABD merkezli araştırma ve danışmanlık şirketi Gartner'ın yayımladığı rapor, yapay zeka teknolojilerine yönelik küresel harcamalardaki büyümenin önümüzdeki dönemde hız kesmeyeceğini ortaya koydu. Rapora göre, yapay zeka yatırımlarının 2027 yılında trilyonlarca dolarlık büyüklüğe ulaşması bekleniyor.
news.articleText: 4 trilyon dolarlık öngörü: Yapay zeka harcamalarına devam edilecek - ABD merkezli araştırma ve danışmanlık şirketi Gartner'ın yayımladığı rapor, yapay zeka teknolojilerine yönelik küresel harcamalardaki büyümenin önümüzdeki dönemde hız kesmeyeceğini ortaya koydu. - Rapora göre, yapay zeka yatırımlarının 2027 yılında trilyonlarca dolarlık büyüklüğe ulaşması bekleniyor. Küresel yapay zeka harcamalarının 2027'de yüzde 47,5 artışla 4,05 trilyon dolara ulaşacağı öngörülüyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Bu kapsamda ABD merkezli araştırma ve danışmanlık şirketi Gartner'ın yayımladığı rapora göre, yapay zeka teknolojileri hızlı büyüme ivmesini koruyor. Dünya genelindeki yapay zeka harcamalarının bu yılki 2,75 trilyon dolar seviyesindeydi. Gelecek yıl yapılacak toplam harcamaların yüzde 59'unun veri merkezleri ve sunucuları kapsayan yapay zeka altyapısına ayrılacağı tahmin ediliyor. Bu alandaki harcamaların 2026'ya kıyasla yüzde 53'ün üzerinde artarak 2,4 trilyon dolara ulaşacağı hesaplanıyor. Altyapı yatırımlarının en büyük kalemini oluşturan yapay zeka için optimize edilmiş sunuculara yönelik harcamaların ise 527,6 milyar dolardan 957,2 milyar dolara yükseleceği öngörülüyor. Diğer öne çıkan harcama kalemleri arasında yüzde 29,5 artışla 746 milyar dolara ulaşması beklenen yapay zeka hizmetleri, yüzde 42 artışla 649 milyar dolarlık hacme erişeceği tahmin edilen yapay zeka yazılımları ve yüzde 69 artışla 86 milyar dolara çıkacağı öngörülen yapay zeka siber güvenliği bulunuyor. Gartner Araştırma Şefi John-David Lovelock, konuya ilişkin değerlendirmesinde, kullanıcı gereksinimlerinin beklenenden hızlı genişlediğini belirtti. Yapay zeka uygulamalarının kullanımı artarken yeni modellerin eğitimi için gereken işlem gücünün de büyüdüğüne dikkati çeken Lovelock, siber güvenlik harcamalarındaki sıçramayı yapay zekanın hem saldırıları hem de savunmayı hızlandırmasına bağladı. Öte yandan, genel yapay zeka harcamalarındaki büyüme hızının 2028 itibarıyla yüzde 28 seviyelerine gerileyerek hafif bir yavaşlama göstereceği öngörülüyor. Gartner'ın raporunda, yalnızca yapay zeka veri merkezlerine odaklanan şirketlerin 2030'a kadar yeterli yatırım getirisi sağlayamayarak risk altına girebileceği uyarısında bulunulurken büyük bulut sağlayıcılarının güçlü gelir akışlarıyla mevcut yatırım hızlarını koruyabileceği vurgulandı.

news.titleTr: Bakan Bayraktar'dan 5 enerji devi için THY modeli: Halka arz sorusuna 'milli şampiyon' vurgusu
news.summaryTr: Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanı Bayraktar, Türkiye Petrolleri, BOTAŞ, EÜAŞ, TEİAŞ ve Eti Maden'in daha güçlü ve küresel ölçekte rekabet edebilir şirketlere dönüştürülmesini hedeflediklerini belirterek, bu şirketler için yapısal reformların planlandığını söyledi.
news.articleText: Bakan Bayraktar'dan 5 enerji devi için THY modeli: Halka arz sorusuna 'milli şampiyon' vurgusu - Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanı Bayraktar, Türkiye Petrolleri, BOTAŞ, EÜAŞ, TEİAŞ ve Eti Maden'in daha güçlü ve küresel ölçekte rekabet edebilir şirketlere dönüştürülmesini hedeflediklerini belirterek, bu şirketler için yapısal reformların planlandığını söyledi. - Bayraktar, halka arz süreçlerine ilişkin takvimin ise önümüzdeki dönemde netleşeceğini ifade etti. Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanı Alparslan Bayraktar, COP31 Zirvesi kapsamında CNBC-e muhabiri Emre Eser'in sorularını yanıtladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Bakan Bayraktar, Türkiye Petrolleri, BOTAŞ, EÜAŞ, TEİAŞ ve Eti Maden'in gelecekteki yapılanmasına ve halka arz süreçlerine ilişkin soruyu yanıtladı. Türkiye'nin enerji ithalatının ekonomi üzerindeki en büyük yüklerden biri olduğunu belirten Bayraktar, birincil enerjide yüzde 68'i bulan dışa bağımlılığın yüzde 48'lere düşürülmesi halinde son 4-5 yılda cari açıkta oluşan 33 milyar dolarlık ortalamanın sıfıra indirilebileceğini söyledi. Bayraktar, program kapsamında söz konusu 5 kamu şirketinin yapacağı yatırımların toplamının 200-210 milyar dolar seviyesinde olduğunu belirterek, BOTAŞ'ın depolama yatırımları, gazlaştırma kapasitesinin artırılması ve yeni iletim hatları gibi projelerinin bulunduğunu ifade etti. THY modeli örnek gösterildi Bu yatırımların gerçekleştirilebilmesi için şirketlerin belirli kabiliyetlere sahip olması gerektiğini vurgulayan Bayraktar, Türk Hava Yolları'nın kamu kimliği ve özel sektörün dinamik yapısıyla küresel ölçekte elde ettiği başarı modelini örnek gösterdi. Bayraktar, benzer bir modelin enerji ve maden şirketleri için de hedeflendiğini belirterek, şunları kaydetti: "Burada bu konu Türkiye'de çok kolay bir şekilde politize edilebiliyor. 'Bunları yabancılara peşkeş çekiyorlar' deniyor. Hiç öyle bir şey yok. Biz tam tersi bu şirketlere yeni kaslar ve yeni kabiliyetler kazandırıyoruz. Kendi sektörünün birer bayrak taşıyıcısı olmasını istiyoruz." Türkiye'nin yurt içindeki enerji üretimini artırırken yurt dışında da güçlü yatırımlar yapması gerektiğini belirten Bayraktar, Gabar'daki petrol üretiminin 85 bin varilden 100 bin varil seviyesini aşmasının 2027'de hedeflendiğini söyledi. Bayraktar, Karadeniz'deki doğal gaz üretiminin önümüzdeki birkaç hafta içerisinde iki katına çıkacağını, 2028'de ise dört katına ulaşacağını bildirdi. 'Milli şampiyonlara ihtiyacımız var' Türkiye'de enerji kaynaklarının aranmasına devam edileceğini vurgulayan Bayraktar, "Türkiye'de ne varsa arayacağız, bulacağız. Ama bizim aynı zamanda dışarıda da Türkiye'de bulduğumuz kadar veya belki daha fazlasını mutlaka bulup ülkemize getirmemiz lazım. Onun için de dışarıda da çok daha güçlü yatırımlar yapabilen milli şampiyonlara ihtiyacımız var." ifadelerini kullandı. Bu şirketlere yeni kabiliyetler kazandırmak amacıyla yapısal reformların planlandığını belirten Bayraktar, söz konusu adımların takviminin önümüzdeki dönemde netleşeceğini kaydetti. Bayraktar, "Kimsenin bir endişesi olmasın, biz bu şirketlerimizi daha güçlü yapmayı hedefliyoruz. Bunlar hepsi bizim için milli şampiyon olma kabiliyeti olacak şirketler." dedi.

news.title: British woman missing from cruise ship in Atlantic
news.summary: The 72-year-old was last seen aboard the Tui ship on Monday as it headed towards the Caribbean.

news.titleTr: British woman missing from cruise ship in Atlantic
news.summaryTr: The 72-year-old was last seen aboard the Tui ship on Monday as it headed towards the Caribbean.
news.articleText: British woman missing from cruise ship in Atlantic - Published A British woman has gone missing from a cruise ship while it was crossing the Atlantic, travel operator Tui has said. The 72-year-old was last seen aboard Tui's Marella Voyager on Monday while the vessel was en route to the Caribbean. The ship could have travelled hundreds of miles in the time between when she was last seen to when she was reported missing. Staff realised the passenger was missing on Tuesday, when they noticed her bed had not been slept in. The alarm was raised and a search carried out, Tui said in a statement. It is understood the missing guest was then reported to the US Coast Guard, which asked the ship to continue to its crossing rather than reverse course and search for the woman. Holidaymakers were told to abandon dinners, drinks and entertainment as the crew carried out an emergency headcount on Tuesday evening, the Daily Mail reports. Passengers stood in lines of four while staff scanned boarding cards to verify the identity of every person on the ship, according to the newspaper. The USCG Rescue Co-ordination Centre in Norfolk, Virginia has issued an alert calling on any ships nearby to "keep a sharp look out" for the woman, the Mail reports. The BBC has contacted the USCG for comment. The Marella Voyager, carrying around 2,000 passengers and 800 crew, left Malaga on 4 November and is due to arrive in Antigua on Friday before calling at Dominica and finishing its voyage in Barbados on Sunday. A spokeswoman for Marella Cruises said it was "deeply saddened" by the disappearance, adding: "Our thoughts are with the guest's loved ones at this very difficult time. "We're supporting the authorities with their enquiries, and out of respect for the guest and their family, we won't be commenting further at this stage." A UK Foreign Office spokesperson said: "We are supporting the family of a British national reported missing on a cruise ship in the Atlantic Ocean and we are in touch with the relevant authorities." In a separate case, a cruise ship pianist was found treading water on Sunday around 20 miles off the Californian coast after falling overboard. Two fishermen discovered the Royal Caribbean employee near Catalina Island and officials believe he may have been in the Pacific Ocean for nine hours, according to CBS News, the BBC's US news partner.
