news.articleText: US envoys arrive in Moscow for Ukraine talks with Vladimir Putin - Published US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff have arrived in Moscow for talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin, a day after the latest talks aimed at ending the war in Ukraine wrapped up in Abu Dhabi. Videos shared by Russian media showed Kushner and Witkoff disembarking a plane and being welcomed by Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev with handshakes and hugs. The American negotiatiors were due to meet Putin at 12:00 local time (09:00 GMT), and will then fly to Dublin to speak to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. On Tuesday, Kushner said the US had seen "some openings and some opportunities" and that they would try to "make some progress" at the meeting with Putin. The in-person talks with the Russian and Ukrainian presidents were only announced on Wednesday after two days of talks which were framed as centred around the postwar security architecture of Europe. Nearly five years since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, Moscow shows no sign of backing down from its maximalist demands for sovereign Ukrainian territory and for Western countries to give up any future commitment to protecting Kyiv in case of further attacks. During the first years of the war, Europeans cut communications with the Kremlin and refused to engage with Russia directly. However, in recent times many have grown concerned about the current US administration's commitment to European security and its softening towards the Kremlin, and have been pushing for a seat at the negotiating table. The talks in Abu Dhabi were led by the Americans and only included Russia and Ukraine, but Kushner said he and Witkoff would ask Putin to "give his blessing" to invite European representatives in future discussions - particularly with regards to the future configuration of their continent's security architecture. Kushner also urged Europe to "identify one person to speak on their behalf" in the negotiations. But the Russians have been opposed to the idea, citing Europe's support for Kyiv as an obstacle. Vladimir Medinsky, who headed the Russian delegation in Abu Dhabi, said he thought all parties had "moved closer to achieving peace" but that now "a lot depends on Ukraine, on the position of the United States, and on whether Europe comes to its senses". As Witkoff and Kushner were meeting Russian officials in Moscow, Zelensky said Ukraine's military was again facing news of "systematic" restrictions to Starshield satellite internet, Elon Musk's SpaceX service which plays a key role for frontline communications. Connectivity issues in October lasted about a week. Musk denied deliberately throttling Ukraine's connection. The restrictions have made it more difficult for Ukrainian forces to intercept Russian jet-powered drones, Zelensky said in a statement. "This is helping the Russians kill more Ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine," he said. "We are trying to clear up all circumstances with the American side." news.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
news.summary: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
news.summaryTr: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.
news.articleText: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century - Published Democrat Scott Colom has won the US Senate race in Mississippi, delivering a shock victory for the party in a deeply conservative state that has elected Republicans for decades. Colom's victory makes him the first black person from Mississippi to be seated in the US Senate since Blanche Bruce served from 1875 to 1881. Fewer than five thousand votes out of nearly a million counted separated him from his Republican opponent, the incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith. The result means the Democrats will hold 55 seats in the 100-member Senate, with a knife-edge race in Alaska still to be called. Colom, 43, won with 49.2% of the vote. Hyde-Smith, who received 48.7%, congratulated Colom in a video posted on X on Wednesday evening and wished him well. "While this was not the outcome we worked for or hoped for, I respect the decision of Mississippi voters," she said. Colom offered a victory speech on the campus of Tougaloo College, met by hundreds of cheering supporters standing side-by-side under the night sky. Excitement filled the air as he thanked them for the support over the days of waiting for a result since the 4 November election. "They did not believe a moment like this was possible, but I kept the faith," Colom said. "It's not something that I did y'all," he continued. "It's something we did." "In Mississippi, it's local people that make the difference." Dozens of people were gathered at the Mississippi HQ of the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People (NAACP) in Jackson on Wednesday when Colom's victory was announced. The room burst into deafening applause and cheers. "This is an amazing result," said Leon Russell, chairman of the NAACP board. "This is purely the work of particularly the black community," he continued. "There was not a whole lot of money, but there was a whole lot of organising. "This is a historic election." Across the room, filled with people embracing, Amber Thomas sat, revelling in the victory. "When you fight, you win," Thomas said. "Right now, I am overwhelmed with joy." The last black senator in the state before Colom was Bruce who was chosen by the state legislature. It has taken a century and a half for the state to choose a new one. Colom strove to engage Republican voters, even going to a Trump rally to speak to people in line outside. Another key moment was his opponent telling voters to "pick another protein" when asked about surging beef prices, something Colom turned into a viral advert of his own., external The contest was never expected to be this close, with Hyde-Smith running for re-election in a state that President Donald Trump won in the 2024 election by more than 22 points. But Democrats have scored a series of major wins in these midterm elections, taking control of both the US House of Representatives and the Senate. The party flipped Senate seats in Republican strongholds, including Texas, South Carolina, Kansas and Iowa. Polls suggest this was due in large part to voter frustrations with the economy and the Iran war under President Trump. Colom appeared to a ride a national wave of resentment against Republicans. Voter backlash against Trump's Republican party has been driven in large part by economic woes, blamed on his administration's tariffs and war with Iran, according to exit polls. Colom, a local prosecutor, used the national mood to his advantage, highlighting his opponent's support for Trump's tariffs and giving her the nickname "Cindy High Prices". The Democrat campaigned aggressively, visiting all of Mississippi's 82 counties. Hyde-Smith's campaign assailed Colom as a puppet of billionaire liberal donor George Soros, whose family has helped fund the Democrat's political campaigns. The 67-year-old Republican was criticised for a lack of public appearances. news.title: Bitcoin'de fırtına öncesi sessizlik mi? Üç kritik sinyal dikkat çekiyor
news.summary: Bitcoin piyasasında üç kritik gelişme yatırımcıların radarına girdi. Boğa piyasası göstergesi sıfıra gerilerken, spot Bitcoin ETF'lerinden sermaye çıkışı hızlandı. Ünlü analist Willy Woo ise mevcut korku ortamının yeni bir fırsat olabileceğini savundu.

news.titleTr: Bitcoin'de fırtına öncesi sessizlik mi? Üç kritik sinyal dikkat çekiyor
news.summaryTr: Bitcoin piyasasında üç kritik gelişme yatırımcıların radarına girdi. Boğa piyasası göstergesi sıfıra gerilerken, spot Bitcoin ETF'lerinden sermaye çıkışı hızlandı. Ünlü analist Willy Woo ise mevcut korku ortamının yeni bir fırsat olabileceğini savundu.
news.articleText: Bitcoin'de fırtına öncesi sessizlik mi? Üç kritik sinyal dikkat çekiyor - Bitcoin piyasasında üç kritik gelişme yatırımcıların radarına girdi. Boğa piyasası göstergesi sıfıra gerilerken, spot Bitcoin ETF'lerinden sermaye çıkışı hızlandı. Ünlü analist Willy Woo ise mevcut korku ortamının yeni bir fırsat olabileceğini savundu. Kripto para piyasasında Bitcoin'e yönelik endişeler artarken, piyasanın geleceğine ilişkin farklı değerlendirmeler öne çıkıyor. Zincir üstü veriler talepte sert bir daralmaya işaret ederken, kurumsal yatırımcıların spot Bitcoin ETF'lerinden çıkışları da hız kazandı. Bitcoin'de ayı piyasası başladı mı? CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Zincir üstü veri analisti Willy Woo, Bitcoin'in yeni dip seviyeler oluşturmaktan uzak olduğunu belirterek henüz ayı piyasası koşullarının oluşmadığını savundu. Glassnode'un Bitcoin Korku ve Açgözlülük Endeksi'ni değerlendiren Woo, piyasa duyarlılığının açgözlülük bölgesinden korku bölgesine gerilediğine dikkat çekti. Geçmiş ayı piyasalarında kalıcı korkunun yeni fiyat dipleriyle ortaya çıktığını belirten Woo, mevcut ortamı boğa piyasasının erken aşamalarında görülen bir fırsat olarak nitelendirdi. Boğa piyasası göstergesi sıfıra geriledi CryptoQuant'ın Bitcoin Bull Score göstergesi, 11 Kasım'da sıfıra gerileyerek mümkün olan en düşük seviyesine ulaştı. CryptoQuant Araştırma Başkanı Julio Moreno, göstergenin 13 Ekim'de 90, 10 Kasım'da ise 20 seviyesinde bulunduğunu belirtti. Son 30 günde Bitcoin'e yönelik görünür talep 284 bin BTC azalarak Mart 2025'ten bu yana en sert daralmayı kaydetti. Coinbase Premium Endeksi'nin 30 gün boyunca negatif bölgede kalması da ABD spot piyasasındaki talebin zayıflığına işaret etti. Geçmişte benzer talep daralmaları yerel dip seviyelerle örtüşürken, mevcut verilerin Bitcoin'de yeni bir dip oluşumunu veya daha derin bir düzeltmeyi henüz doğrulamadığı belirtildi. Bitcoin ETF'lerinden beş gündür çıkış yaşanıyor ABD'de işlem gören spot Bitcoin ETF'lerinden 11 Kasım'da 299,9 milyon dolarlık net sermaye çıkışı gerçekleşti. Böylece 5 Kasım'da başlayan çıkış serisi beşinci işlem gününe taşınırken, günlük çıkış tutarı bir önceki güne göre yaklaşık 3,2 katına yükseldi. Spot Bitcoin ETF'lerinin kuruluşlarından bu yana toplam net sermaye girişi 55,1 milyar dolar seviyesinde gerçekleşirken, fonların toplam net varlık değeri 93,7 milyar dolara geriledi. Bu tutar, Bitcoin'in toplam piyasa değerinin yaklaşık yüzde 6,24'üne karşılık geliyor.

news.title: Nvidia'da Huang için kritik toplantı: Çip devinde CEO hazırlığı
news.summary: Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, CEO Jensen Huang'ın görevden alınıp alınmayacağını değerlendirmek üzere toplandı.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Nvidia'da Huang için kritik toplantı: Çip devinde CEO hazırlığı
news.summaryTr: Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, CEO Jensen Huang'ın görevden alınıp alınmayacağını değerlendirmek üzere toplandı.
news.articleText: Nvidia'da Huang için kritik toplantı: Çip devinde CEO hazırlığı - Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, CEO Jensen Huang'ın görevden alınıp alınmayacağını değerlendirmek üzere toplandı. - Çin adına casusluk yaptığı öne sürülen bir iş kadınıyla ilişkisi ve şirket yöneticilerinden biriyle yaşadığı iddia edilen ilişki, dünyanın en değerli çip üreticilerinden birinde liderlik krizini derinleştirdi. Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, CEO Jensen Huang'ın görevden alınıp alınmamasını değerlendirmek üzere çarşamba günü toplandı. Şirketin Çin adına casusluk yaptığı öne sürülen bir iş kadınıyla ilişkisi hakkındaki iddialar ve başka bir ilişki haberleri, çip üreticisinde yönetim krizini derinleştirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Reuters'a konuşan konuya yakın bir kaynak, Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu'nun Huang'ın görevden alınmasını görüşmek üzere toplandığını söyledi. Nvidia, yönetim kurulunun pazar günü Huang ve yönetim ekibine güven duyduğunu açıklamasının ardından yaşanan bu gelişmeye ilişkin yorum talebine hemen yanıt vermedi. Şirketin iç tüzüğüne göre Huang, yönetim kurulu üyelerinin çoğunluğunun oyuyla gerekçeli veya gerekçesiz görevden alınabiliyor. Nvidia'nın 11 üyeli yönetim kurulunda Huang dışındaki tüm üyeler bağımsız olarak kabul ediliyor. Wall Street Journal'ın şirketin Huang'ı görevden almaya hazırlandığını bildirmesinin ardından Nvidia hisseleri perşembe günü Frankfurt işlemlerinin erken saatlerinde yaklaşık yüzde 7 geriledi. Kayıpların korunması halinde şirketin piyasa değeri, yönetim kurulunun soruşturma başlattığını duyurmasından bu yana yaklaşık 600 milyar dolar azalmış olacak. Şirketin geleceği ve halef tartışması Habere göre Huang'ın görevden ayrılmasının, kurucuları arasında yer aldığı ve 30 yılı aşkın süredir yönettiği Nvidia'da liderlik boşluğu yaratabileceği aktarıldı. Yaklaşık 4 trilyon dolarlık piyasa değerine sahip şirketin, yapay zeka çiplerinin küresel ölçekteki en büyük tedarikçisi konumunda bulunduğu ifade edildi. 63 yaşındaki Huang'ın belirgin bir halefi bulunmuyor. Şirket hisselerinin yaklaşık yüzde 3,6'sına sahip olan Huang'ın onlarca doğrudan raporlayan yöneticisi bulunması, Nvidia üzerindeki güçlü kontrolünü ortaya koyduğu aktarıldı. Yeni CEO için danışmanlık ABD'li kaynakların haberine göre yönetim kurulu, Huang'ın yerine geçebilecek isimleri belirlemek üzere dışarıdan bir danışmanlık şirketiyle çalışıyor. Minotaur Capital'in kurucu ortağı ve portföy yöneticisi Armina Rosenberg, Finans Direktörü Colette Kress'in geçici CEO olarak doğal bir tercih olabileceğini ancak asıl sorunun şirketin uzun vadeli teknoloji stratejisini kimin yöneteceği olduğunu belirtti. Tahmin piyasası Polymarket'te Huang'ın yıl sonuna kadar istifa etmesi veya görevden alınması ihtimaline ilişkin oran yüzde 88'e yükseldi. Halef adayları arasında Nvidia'nın veri merkezi müşterilerine yönelik işlerini yöneten Ian Buck öne çıktı. Şirketin 17 Kasım'da açıklaması beklenen finansal sonuçları ve gelecek döneme ilişkin beklentileri öncesinde yaşanan gelişmeler, yatırımcıların gündemine oturdu. İki ayrı ilişki iddiası gündemde ABD istihbaratının, Alice Huang adlı iş kadınının Nvidia çiplerinin Çinli şirketlere sevkiyatını kolaylaştırdığı iddiasını araştırdığına ilişkin haberler, şirket üzerindeki baskıyı artırdı. Alice Huang'ın Çin adına casusluk yaptığı öne sürülürken Pekin yönetimi iddiaları reddetti. Reuters, Alice Huang'a ulaşamadığını bildirdi. ABD'li kaynkalara göre Alice Huang, güvenlik yetkililerinin bilgisi dahilinde Pekin'de yaşıyor. New York Times ise çarşamba günü Jensen Huang'ın şirket yöneticilerinden biriyle de evlilik dışı ilişki yaşadığını öne sürdü. Gazetenin beş eski çalışanına dayandırdığı haberinde, söz konusu kişinin Nvidia'nın sağlık alanından sorumlu başkan yardımcısı Kimberly Powell olduğu belirtildi. Huang, gazetenin Powell ile ilişkisine yönelik sorusuna doğrudan kendisine soru sorulmaması gerektiğini söyleyerek yanıt verdi. Nvidia ve Powell, Reuters'ın yorum taleplerine hemen karşılık vermedi. Huang, pazar günü çalışanlara gönderdiği mesajda eşine sadık kalmadığını kabul etmiş ve “tam sorumluluk” aldığını belirtmiş ancak ilişkiye ilişkin ayrıntı vermemişti. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump da pazartesi günü Huang ile görüştüğünü ve CEO'nun söz konusu kadının casusluk yaptığı iddiasından haberdar olmadığını söylediğini aktarmıştı. Huang'ın iddialar hakkında kapalı kapılar ardında bilgilendirme yapması yönündeki talebe yanıt vermemesi halinde Kongre tarafından ifadeye çağrılabileceği belirtiliyor.
news.articleTextTr: Nvidia'da Huang için kritik toplantı: Çip devinde CEO hazırlığı - Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, CEO Jensen Huang'ın görevden alınıp alınmayacağını değerlendirmek üzere toplandı. - Çin adına casusluk yaptığı öne sürülen bir iş kadınıyla ilişkisi ve şirket yöneticilerinden biriyle yaşadığı iddia edilen ilişki, dünyanın en değerli çip üreticilerinden birinde liderlik krizini derinleştirdi. Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, CEO Jensen Huang'ın görevden alınıp alınmamasını değerlendirmek üzere çarşamba günü toplandı. Şirketin Çin adına casusluk yaptığı öne sürülen bir iş kadınıyla ilişkisi hakkındaki iddialar ve başka bir ilişki haberleri, çip üreticisinde yönetim krizini derinleştirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Reuters'a konuşan konuya yakın bir kaynak, Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu'nun Huang'ın görevden alınmasını görüşmek üzere toplandığını söyledi. Nvidia, yönetim kurulunun pazar günü Huang ve yönetim ekibine güven duyduğunu açıklamasının ardından yaşanan bu gelişmeye ilişkin yorum talebine hemen yanıt vermedi. Şirketin iç tüzüğüne göre Huang, yönetim kurulu üyelerinin çoğunluğunun oyuyla gerekçeli veya gerekçesiz görevden alınabiliyor. Nvidia'nın 11 üyeli yönetim kurulunda Huang dışındaki tüm üyeler bağımsız olarak kabul ediliyor. Wall Street Journal'ın şirketin Huang'ı görevden almaya hazırlandığını bildirmesinin ardından Nvidia hisseleri perşembe günü Frankfurt işlemlerinin erken saatlerinde yaklaşık yüzde 7 geriledi. Kayıpların korunması halinde şirketin piyasa değeri, yönetim kurulunun soruşturma başlattığını duyurmasından bu yana yaklaşık 600 milyar dolar azalmış olacak. news.title: What's happening to the UK economy and how does it affect you?
news.summary: The rate of UK economic growth affects things like pay increases and the amount of tax raised.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: What's happening to the UK economy and how does it affect you?
news.summaryTr: The rate of UK economic growth affects things like pay increases and the amount of tax raised.
news.articleText: What's happening to the UK economy and how does it affect you? - Published The UK economy grew at its fastest rate for more than two years in the three months to September, with analysts describing its performance as robust despite the impact of higher energy costs. Economic growth matters because it affects things like pay increases for workers and the amount of tax the government raises to pay for services. What is GDP and why does it matter? UK economic growth is measured by the change in the country's GDP, or gross domestic product. This includes all the economic activity of companies, governments, and people in a country. In the UK, the Office for National Statistics (ONS) publishes new GDP figures every month, external. However, these can vary quite a lot and the quarterly figures – covering three months at a time – are considered more significant. Most economists, politicians and businesses like to see GDP rising steadily. That's because it usually means people are spending more, extra jobs are created, more tax is paid, and workers get better pay rises. When GDP is falling, it means the economy is shrinking. This can be bad news for businesses and workers as it can lead to pay freezes and job losses. If GDP falls for two quarters in a row, that is known as a recession. What is happening to the UK economy? In the July-to-September quarter the UK economy grew by 0.7%. That was the fastest growth since the start of 2024, and followed growth of 0.5% and 0.6% in the first two quarters of 2026. Economists say the UK has been weathering the energy shock from the US-Israel war with Iran better than had been expected. The outbreak of the conflict has severely disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a narrow waterway south of Iran through which one fifth of the world's oil and gas usually flows. This closure, along with Russia's invasion of Ukraine, has contributed to a sharp jump in oil prices, which has fed through to higher energy and fuel prices. Economists expect UK growth to remain resilient but slow in the months ahead as those costs continue to affect households and businesses. In April, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) forecast the Iran war would hit the UK the hardest of the world's advanced economies. However, the IMF recently upgraded its forecast for the UK economy to 1.3% expansion this year, noting that the global economy had proved more resilient than expected to the shock of the Iran war. Independent forecasters have been slightly less optimistic - among them the average prediction is 1.2%, external. The Labour government has repeatedly said growth is its top priority, but has faced criticism for achieving only moderate economic growth since it took power in 2024. The ONS has revised down its estimate for 2025 and now calculates GDP grew by 1.2% last year, external. In addition, the ONS calculates that the amount people have to spend after inflation is taken into account - measured as real household disposable income per head - was up 1.2% between June 2025 and June 2026. - UK growth forecast upgraded by IMF but risks remain - Published18 May - How the Iran war affects your money and bills - Published16 June How does GDP affect tax and public services? If GDP is going up steadily, people pay more in tax because they're earning and spending more. This means more money for the government, which it can choose to spend on public services, such as schools, police and hospitals. When the economy shrinks and a country goes into recession, these things can go into reverse. Governments tend to get less money in tax, which means they may decide to freeze or cut public spending, or put taxes up. In 2020, the Covid pandemic caused the most severe UK recession for more than 300 years. In response, the government borrowed hundreds of billions of pounds to support the economy. - Why are UK prices still rising? - Published21 October - Will UK interest rates go up? - Published4 November How is GDP measured? GDP can be measured in three ways: Output: The total value of goods and services produced by all sectors of the economy – agriculture, manufacturing, energy, construction, the service sector, and government. Expenditure: The value of goods and services bought by households and by government as well as investment in machinery and buildings. It also includes the value of exports, minus imports. Income: The value of the income generated, mostly in terms of profits and wages. In the UK, the ONS publishes one single measure of GDP, which is calculated using all three measurements. But early estimates mainly use the output measure, using data collected from thousands of companies. Why does the GDP figure sometimes change? The UK produces one of the quickest estimates of GDP of the major economies, about 40 days after the quarter in question. At that stage, only about 60% of the data is available, so the figure is revised as more information comes in. The ONS publishes more information about this on its website, external. What are the limitations of the GDP figure? GDP is not the whole story as it does not include several things: The hidden economy: Unpaid work such as caring for children or elderly relatives isn't captured. Inequality: Rising GDP could result from the richest getting richer, rather than everyone becoming better off, and some people could be worse off. Living standards: If the population is also growing, increased GDP can still mean less money per person, which can reduce people's living standards. This is why the GDP per capita measure is important. Some critics also argue that GDP doesn't take into account whether the economic growth it measures is sustainable, or the environmental damage it might do. Alternative measures have been developed which try to capture this. Since 2010, the ONS has also measured well-being, external alongside economic growth. This assesses health, relationships, education and skills, as well as people's personal finances and the environment. But despite its limitations, GDP is still the most widely used measure for most government decisions and international comparisons.

news.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
news.summary: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
news.summaryTr: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.
news.articleText: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says - Published At least six people have been killed and about 20 injured in an Israeli air strike on Nasser hospital, the biggest in the southern Gaza Strip, the Hamas-run health ministry says. Eyewitnesses told the BBC that a single missile fired by a warplane hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units overnight. The health ministry said medical staff, patients and companions were killed, among them surgeon Dr Rizk Abu Shaira. It condemned the attack as a "flagrant violation of international laws and conventions". The Israeli military said it targeted a commander of Hamas's armed wing and other fighters who had used the hospital as a "headquarters" to plan attacks on its forces. Hamas said that Israel was spreading "false narratives" in a "blatant attempt to cover up a new war crime". Under international law, hospitals have a protected status, but they have been repeatedly targeted during the Gaza war. Israel accuses Hamas, which retains security control of parts of Gaza not occupied by Israeli troops, of cynically exploiting civilian infrastructure. It says the group stores weapons and runs command and control rooms in hospitals, which Hamas denies. Israel does not allow international news organisations, including the BBC, into Gaza, making it difficult to verify what is happening in the territory. In a video posted on social media, a paramedic from the Civil Defence agency who arrived at the building after the strike early on Thursday said the missile penetrated the five-storey structure and hit a room in the surgical department. A spokesman for the Civil Defence, which operates under the Hamas-run interior ministry, initially said that five people had been killed and 20 others injured. Videos shared by activists showed thick smoke inside the building and extensive destruction on the second floor, where medical equipment and beds had been scattered by the blast. Local activists have also circulated claims that the strike may have targeted a senior Hamas security figure who was hiding inside the building. Speaking to reporters in the aftermath of the strike, the director of Nasser hospital said the building had been hit in a vertical strike, causing extensive damage. Nasser hospital was hit by a double Israeli strike in August 2025, which killed at least 20 people, including journalists and health workers. Israeli strikes on Gaza have continued despite a ceasefire agreement in October last year. More than 1,620 people have been killed since then, according to the territory's health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN. Israel and Hamas have accused each other of violating the ceasefire. The humanitarian crisis in Gaza has recently worsened as a result of heavy rains that reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents housing displaced families. The Gaza war was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on southern Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others were taken hostage. Since then, more than 74,650 people have been killed in Gaza, the health ministry says.

news.titleTr: Emekli zammı sil baştan! TCMB enflasyon senaryosu sonrası yeni hesap
news.summaryTr: Ocak ayında milyonlarca emeklinin maaş artışını belirleyecek hesaplamalarda yılın son iki ayındaki enflasyon verileri öne çıkıyor. İşte TCMB'nin 2026 yıl sonu için öngördüğü yüzde 29,5 enflasyonu yapılan hesaplamalar...
news.articleText: Emekli zammı sil baştan! TCMB enflasyon senaryosu sonrası yeni hesap Ocak ayında milyonlarca emeklinin maaş artışını belirleyecek hesaplamalarda yılın son iki ayındaki enflasyon verileri öne çıkıyor. İşte TCMB'nin 2026 yıl sonu için öngördüğü yüzde 29,5 enflasyonu yapılan hesaplamalar... 2027 Ocak emekli zammı nasıl hesaplanıyor? Emekli maaşlarına yapılacak ocak zammında SSK ve Bağ-Kur emeklileri ile memur emeklileri için farklı hesaplama yöntemleri uygulanıyor. SSK ve Bağ-Kur emeklilerinin maaşları, her yıl ocak ve temmuz aylarında önceki altı aylık dönemde gerçekleşen enflasyon oranında artırılıyor. Bu nedenle 2027 ocak zammını belirleyecek veri, 2026'nın temmuz-aralık dönemindeki toplam TÜFE artışı olacak. Memur emeklilerinin aylıklarında ise toplu sözleşmeyle belirlenen zam oranı uygulanıyor. Altı aylık enflasyonun ilgili dönem için belirlenen toplu sözleşme artışını aşması halinde aradaki fark enflasyon farkı olarak maaşlara ekleniyor. 2027 yılının ilk altı ayı için memur ve memur emeklilerine yüzde 5 toplu sözleşme zammı öngörülüyor. Dört aylık enflasyon yüzde 8,28'e ulaştı TÜİK'in açıkladığı verilere göre tüketici fiyatları 2026'nın temmuz ayında yüzde 1,78, ağustos ayında yüzde 1,84, eylül ayında yüzde 1,84 ve ekim ayında yüzde 2,58 arttı. Böylece temmuz-ekim dönemindeki dört aylık kümülatif enflasyon yüzde 8,28 olarak hesaplandı. Bu oran, SSK ve Bağ-Kur emeklilerinin ocak ayında alacağı zam için şimdiden oluşan artışı gösteriyor. Kasım ve aralık ayı enflasyonunun açıklanmasıyla altı aylık toplam oran kesinleşecek. Yüzde 29,5 enflasyon tahminine göre ksım ve aralık enflasyonları ne kadar olabilir? TCMB'nin 2026 yıl sonu enflasyon tahmini yüzde 29,5 seviyesinde bulunuyor. Bu tahminin gerçekleşmesi için kasım ve aralık aylarında aylık enflasyonun farklı kombinasyonlarla şekillenmesi gerekiyor. Kasım ayında yüzde 1 enflasyon gerçekleşmesi halinde aralık ayı enflasyonunun yaklaşık yüzde 0,55 olması, kasımda yüzde 1,25 artış görülmesi halinde ise aralık enflasyonunun yüzde 0,30 seviyesinde kalması gerekiyor. İşte farklı senaryolar Bu senaryoların emekli zamlarına yansıması şöyle: Hesaplamalarda temmuz-ekim dönemindeki gerçekleşmeler ile tabloda yer alan kasım-aralık oranları bileşik olarak kullanıldı. Oranlar yuvarlandığı için senaryolar arasında küçük farklılıklar bulunuyor. SSK ve Bağ-Kur emeklisinin zammı nasıl hesaplanıyor? SSK ve Bağ-Kur emeklilerinin ocak zammı, temmuz-aralık dönemindeki altı aylık enflasyonun doğrudan maaşlara yansıtılmasıyla belirleniyor. Verilen senaryolarda altı aylık enflasyon yaklaşık yüzde 9,97 seviyesinde oluşuyor. Bu durumda mevcut emekli aylığı yüzde 9,97 artırılacak. Örneğin 25 bin TL emekli aylığı alan bir SSK veya Bağ-Kur emeklisinin maaşı, yüzde 9,97 zam varsayımıyla yaklaşık 27 bin 493 TL'ye yükselecek. 30 bin TL aylık alan bir emeklinin maaşı ise yaklaşık 32 bin 991 TL olacak. Memur emeklisi zammı nasıl hesaplanıyor? Memur emeklilerinin maaş artışında iki unsur bulunuyor: toplu sözleşme zammı ve enflasyon farkı. 2026'nın ikinci yarısı için belirlenen toplu sözleşme zammı yüzde 7, 2027'nin ilk yarısı için öngörülen artış ise yüzde 5. Temmuz-aralık dönemindeki altı aylık enflasyonun yüzde 7'yi aşan kısmı, memur emeklilerine enflasyon farkı olarak yansıtılıyor. Altı aylık enflasyonun yüzde 9,97 olması halinde enflasyon farkı yaklaşık yüzde 2,77 olarak hesaplanıyor. Bu farkın 2027'nin ilk yarısı için belirlenen yüzde 5'lik toplu sözleşme zammıyla birleştirilmesi sonucunda toplam artış yaklaşık yüzde 7,91 oluyor. Örneğin 35 bin TL memur emeklisi aylığı alan bir kişinin maaşı, yüzde 7,91 zam varsayımıyla yaklaşık 37 bin 769 TL'ye çıkıyor. 40 bin TL aylık alan bir memur emeklisinin maaşı ise yaklaşık 43 bin 165 TL oluyor. En düşük emekli maaşı ne kadar olacak? Temmuz 2026 itibarıyla en düşük emekli aylığı 23 bin 552 TL olarak uygulanıyor. Ancak en düşük emekli aylığı ile emeklinin kök aylığı birbirinden farklı. En düşük aylık uygulaması, kök maaşı belirlenen taban tutarın altında kalan emeklilere yapılan ödemeyi tamamlıyor. Bu nedenle en düşük emekli aylığının ocak ayında ne kadar olacağı yalnızca enflasyon hesabıyla kesinleşmiyor. Taban tutarın artırılması için ayrıca yasal düzenleme yapılması gerekiyor. Mevcut 23 bin 552 TL'lik taban tutarın yüzde 9,97 artırılması halinde tutar yaklaşık 25 bin 900 TL'ye ulaşır. Ancak bu hesaplama, en düşük emekli aylığının aynı oranda artırılacağı varsayımına dayanıyor; yeni taban tutar için ayrıca karar alınması gerekiyor. Kesin zam oranları ne zaman belli olacak? 2027 ocak ayında emekli maaşlarına uygulanacak kesin artış oranları, TÜİK'in aralık ayı enflasyonunu açıklamasıyla belli olacak. SSK ve Bağ-Kur emeklilerinin zam oranı altı aylık enflasyona göre, memur emeklilerinin artışı ise toplu sözleşme zammı ve enflasyon farkına göre hesaplanacak. Bu hesaplamalar enflasyon senaryolarına dayanıyor. Refah payı, seyyanen zam veya en düşük emekli aylığına yönelik yeni bir yasal düzenleme yapılması halinde ödenecek tutarlar değişebilecek.

news.summary: Avrupa'nın en büyük organizasyonları olan Şampiyonlar Ligi, Avrupa Ligi, Avrupa Konferans Ligi ve UEFA Süper Kupası, 2027-2028 sezonundan itibaren 4 yıl boyunca yeniden Acun Ilıcalı'nın sahibi olduğu Exxen'de yayınlanacak.

news.titleTr: Şampiyonlar Ligi ve Avrupa Kupalarının yayın hakları 4 yıllığına Exxen'de

news.articleText: Şampiyonlar Ligi ve Avrupa Kupalarının yayın hakları 4 yıllığına Exxen'de YAYIN TARİHİ, 12 Kasım 2026 12:24 PAYLAŞ - Avrupa'nın en büyük organizasyonları olan Şampiyonlar Ligi, Avrupa Ligi, Avrupa Konferans Ligi ve UEFA Süper Kupası, 2027-2028 sezonundan itibaren 4 yıl boyunca yeniden Acun Ilıcalı'nın sahibi olduğu Exxen'de yayınlanacak. Avrupa futbolunun kulüp düzeyindeki en prestijli organizasyonları, 2027-2028 sezonundan itibaren 4 yıl boyunca yeniden Exxen ekranlarına dönüyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 2027-2028 sezonu itibariyle UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi, UEFA Avrupa Ligi, UEFA Avrupa Konferans Ligi ve UEFA Süper Kupası'nın tüm heyecanı yine futbolseverlerle buluşacak. UEFA ve TRT'nin anlaşması bu yıl sona erecek. Exxen önümüzdeki sezondan 2030-31 sezonu sonuna kadar Avrupa maçlarını yayınlayacak.

Gür, Sürdürülebilir İklimlendirme Finansman Programı ile işletmelerin enerji verimliliği yatırımlarını ve düşük karbonlu ekonomiye geçişini desteklediklerini belirtti.

news.summaryTr: Akbank Genel Müdürü Kaan Gür, COP31 kapsamında düzenlenen panelde iklim dönüşümünde finans sektörünün rolüne dikkat çekti. Gür, Sürdürülebilir İklimlendirme Finansman Programı ile işletmelerin enerji verimliliği yatırımlarını ve düşük karbonlu ekonomiye geçişini desteklediklerini belirtti.
news.articleText: Akbank'tan COP31'de sürdürülebilir finans mesajı: İşletmelerin dönüşümüne destek - Akbank Genel Müdürü Kaan Gür, COP31 kapsamında düzenlenen panelde iklim dönüşümünde finans sektörünün rolüne dikkat çekti. Gür, Sürdürülebilir İklimlendirme Finansman Programı ile işletmelerin enerji verimliliği yatırımlarını ve düşük karbonlu ekonomiye geçişini desteklediklerini belirtti. Akbank Genel Müdürü Kaan Gür, COP31 kapsamında UNDP tarafından düzenlenen üst düzey panelde Türkiye’nin Ulusal Soğutma Eylem Planı’nın uygulanmasında finans sektörünün rolünü değerlendirdi. Gür, Akbank’ın Sürdürülebilir İklimlendirme Finansman Programı ile işletmelerin daha verimli sistemlere geçişini ve uluslararası kaynaklarla Türkiye’deki yatırım önceliklerinin buluşturulmasını desteklediklerini belirtti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Akbank Genel Müdürü Kaan Gür, BM İklim Değişikliği Çerçeve Sözleşmesi 31. Taraflar Konferansı (COP31) kapsamında, Birleşmiş Milletler Kalkınma Programı (UNDP) tarafından düzenlenen “Kamu-Özel Sektör İş Birliği ve Sürdürülebilir Finans Yoluyla Türkiye’nin Ulusal Soğutma Eylem Planı’nın Uygulanmasının Hızlandırılması” başlıklı panele katıldı. Moderatörlüğünü UNDP Türkiye Mukim Temsilci Yardımcısı Tomica Paović’in üstlendiği; konuşmacılar arasında T.C. Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanlığı İklim Değişikliği Başkanlığı Başkan Yardımcısı Mehrali Ecer, UNDP Türkiye İklim Değişikliği ve Çevre Portföy Yöneticisi Meral Mungan Arda, Guidehouse Direktörü Katja Eisbrenner ile İklimlendirme Soğutma Klima İmalatçıları Derneği Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Süleyman Kavas’ın da yer aldığı panelde, Türkiye’nin soğutma alanındaki önceliklerinin uygulanabilir ve ölçeklenebilir projelere dönüştürülmesi konusu ele alındı. Konuya ilişkin yaptığı açıklamada Akbank Genel Müdürü Kaan Gür, “Soğutma sistemlerinin verimliliği, emisyonların azaltılmasının yanında işletmelerin maliyetlerini ve faaliyetlerini sürdürme gücünü de doğrudan etkiliyor. Türkiye’nin Ulusal Soğutma Eylem Planı bu alanda ülkemizin yönünü ve dönüşüm stratejisini belirliyor. Önceliğimiz, plandaki hedefleri işletmelerin hayata geçirebileceği yatırımlara dönüştürmek olmalı. Bankalar, geniş müşteri ağları sayesinde öncelikli sektörleri ve yatırım ihtiyaçlarını sahada belirleyebilir; işletmelerin uygun teknolojilere ve gerekli teknik yetkinliklere erişimini destekleyebilir. Mevcut sürdürülebilir finansman ürünlerini bu yatırımlarla buluştururken, kalkınma kuruluşları ve teknoloji uzmanlarıyla iş birlikleri kurabilir. Böylece enerji tasarrufunu, emisyon azaltımını ve ekonomik getiriyi görünür hâle getirerek işletmelerin yatırım kararlarını kolaylaştırabilir ve daha verimli sistemlere geçişi hızlandırabilir. Bu doğrultuda Akbank olarak sürdürülebilir iklimlendirme yatırımlarını daha kolay belirlenen, ölçülen ve finanse edilen bir yapıya kavuşturmak için çalışıyoruz. Cool Up Programı’nın Türkiye’deki ilk finansal partneri olarak hayata geçirdiğimiz Sürdürülebilir İklimlendirme Finansman Programımızla bu süreci destekliyoruz. Amacımız, uluslararası kaynaklarla Türkiye’deki yatırım önceliklerini buluşturarak daha verimli sistemlere geçişi kolaylaştırmak ve ekonominin iklim değişikliğine karşı dayanıklılığını artırmak” dedi.

news.titleTr: Maliyet hesabı şaşırttı: Benzin ve motorine fiyatları elektrikli araçlara talebi artırdı

news.articleText: Maliyet hesabı şaşırttı: Benzin ve motorine fiyatları elektrikli araçlara talebi artırdı - İngiltere'de benzin ve motorin fiyatlarındaki artış elektrikli otomobil satışlarını destekledi. Ancak beş farklı model üzerinden yapılan karşılaştırma, elektrikli araçların evde şarj edilse bile her zaman daha düşük maliyet sunmadığını, hızlı şarjda ise avantajın çoğunlukla kaybolduğunu gösterdi. ABD ile İran arasındaki çatışmanın etkisiyle İngiltere'de akaryakıt fiyatlarının yükselmesi, sürücülerin elektrikli otomobillere yönelmesini hızlandırdı. Ancak yeni araçlardaki indirimler ve şarj maliyetleri dikkate alındığında elektrikli otomobil tercihinin her durumda daha ekonomik olmadığı ortaya çıktı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Daily Mail'in haberine göre, İngiltere'de benzin fiyatları şubat ayına kıyasla litre başına yaklaşık 41 peni, motorin fiyatları ise 57 peni arttı. Bu artış, 55 litrelik bir deponun doldurulma maliyetini benzinli araçlarda yaklaşık 23 sterlin, dizel araçlarda 32 sterlin yükseltti. Akaryakıt maliyetlerindeki artış, elektrikli araçlara olan talebi de destekledi. Ocak-ekim döneminde yeni benzinli otomobil satışları yıllık yüzde 4,4 düşerek yaklaşık 35 bin 600 adet azalırken, dizel araç satışları yüzde 7,8 gerileyerek 83 bin 500'e indi. Tam elektrikli araç satışları yüzde 30,4, şarj edilebilir hibrit satışları ise yüzde 40 arttı. İngiliz Otomobil Birliği AA'nın Elektrikli Araçlara Hazırlık Endeksi'ne göre, elektrikli otomobile geçmeyi değerlendiren sürücülerin oranı 100 üzerinden 60'a yükseldi. Bu oran bir yıldan biraz daha uzun süre önce 47,5 seviyesindeydi. Benzinli ve dizel araçlarda indirimler azaldı Araç satışlarındaki gerilemeye rağmen bayilerin benzinli ve dizel modellerde indirimleri artırmak yerine azalttığı görüldü. Insider Car Deals verilerine göre, yeni benzinli otomobillerde ortalama indirim şubat ayındaki yüzde 10,8 seviyesinden kasımda yüzde 10,2'ye geriledi. Dizel araçlardaki indirim oranı da aynı dönemde yüzde 9,7'den yüzde 8,5'e düştü. Hibrit otomobillerde indirimler yüzde 11,3 seviyesinde sabit kalırken, elektrikli araçlardaki ortalama indirim oranı yıl başındaki yüzde 13 seviyesinden yüzde 11,1'e indi. Elektrikli araç her zaman daha ucuz değil Insider Car Deals, beş farklı araç çiftini karşılaştırarak elektrikli ve içten yanmalı motorlu modellerin aylık maliyetlerini inceledi. Hesaplamalarda yıllık 7 bin mil (yaklaşık 11 bin 265 kilometre) kullanım, araçların PCP finansman ödemeleri ve yakıt veya şarj giderleri dikkate alındı. Evde düşük tarifeli elektrikle şarj edilen araçlarda bile beş karşılaştırmanın yalnızca üçünde elektrikli model daha düşük aylık maliyet sundu. Halka açık hızlı şarj istasyonlarının kullanılması durumunda ise elektrikli araçların maliyet avantajı çoğunlukla ortadan kalktı.

news.title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
news.summary: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
news.summaryTr: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.
news.articleText: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying - Published Indonesia's Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka tendered his resignation to parliament on Thursday, triggering the process of finding his replacement amid growing turmoil for the government. Gibran had been facing impeachment calls after a Supreme Court ruling that a high-school document used during his 2024 election campaign was invalid. His departure comes amid a faltering political alliance between his father, ex-president Joko Widodo, and the incumbent President Prabowo Subianto. Standing alongside Gibran, Prabowo told reporters he had accepted his resignation with "a heavy heart". Upper house lawmakers will have 60 days to fill the vacancy from two candidates nominated by the president. "[Gibran] has demonstrated a chivalrous attitude, a strong sense of responsibility, and the qualities of a statesman," Prabowo said, adding that the resignation was "for the benefit of the nation, the state, and the people of Indonesia". "He certainly believes that he completed his education through a proper and structured process. However, we must understand that educational systems abroad differ from those in Indonesia," the president said. Gibran has long faced controversy over whether his high school qualifications met legal requirements to run for office. Having studied in Singapore and Australia, he had used an Indonesian equivalence certificate to demonstrate his educational credentials. Indonesian law requires vice-presidents to have completed senior secondary school or its equivalent, but the Supreme Court found no evidence to prove Gibran had graduated. "No evidence was found to show Gibran had a foreign diploma or certificate that could serve as the basis for equivalency with a senior high school or equivalent qualification," it said. It also considered a Constitutional Court ruling from earlier in October which came to the same conclusion. The Supreme Court ruling prompted more than 100 lawmakers to support a parliamentary initiative that could have paved the way for proceedings to impeach Gibran. Gibran previously argued that undertaking university education was sufficient proof that he had completed senior high school. On Tuesday, he asked for the chance to challenge the ruling and be given the opportunity to prove the legitimacy of his education credentials, State Secretariat Prasetyo Hadi said. Gibran's ascension to Prabowo's ticket in the 2024 election was part of an alliance formed between his father, outgoing president Joko Widodo - known as Jokowi - and Prabowo, his erstwhile bitter rival. Gibran was 36 at the time, and only became eligible for candidacy after a controversial ruling by the Constitutional Court, which exempted him from the minimum age requirement of 40. But tensions between Jokowi and Prabowo appear to have flared. Since taking the presidency, Prabowo has shown little interest in pushing ahead with Jokowi's legacy project: the construction of Nusantara, a new capital. Instead, he has focused much of the state's resources on his own flagship programme to provide free school meals across the country. In a series of personnel reshuffles over the past year, Prabowo has also shifted many Jokowi loyalists into new roles, including long-serving finance minister Sri Mulyani Indrawati. Last week, authorities arrested several senior officials, including presidential chief of staff Listyo Sigit Prabowo - no relation to Prabowo - on suspicions of wiretapping the president. Prabowo sacked Listyo a day later, in what many pointed to as a sign of a crumbling alliance: Listyo, who formerly served as the national police chief, is widely considered a long-time ally of Jokowi. Within the government, allegiances seem to be shifting. On Monday, three members of Prabowo's cabinet collectively resigned from the party led by Kaesang Pangarep, Jokowi's youngest son, citing their desire to focus on their duties in Prabowo's administration. But neither man has confirmed the rift. Speaking to reporters on Thursday, Jokowi said he still supported Prabowo's leadership. Jokowi also said Gibran's resignation was part of "political dynamics" and he had told his son "the position was temporary". All this is unfolding at a particularly turbulent period in Prabowo's presidency. The free school meals programme is struggling for funding, parts of Indonesia have recently battled the country's worst wildfires in a decade, and the national stock market faces crisis amid allegations of widespread market manipulation. Across the country, students and activists have staged demonstrations to protest against the government's handling of a range of issues, including the environmental crisis and corruption. news.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $2B over nine sessions
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows rose to nearly $300 million on Wednesday, up from $95 million a day earlier, as five-session withdrawals reached $1.44 billion.

news.titleTr: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $2B over nine sessions
news.summaryTr: US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows rose to nearly $300 million on Wednesday, up from $95 million a day earlier, as five-session withdrawals reached $1.44 billion.
news.articleText: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $2B over nine sessions US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows rose to nearly $300 million on Wednesday, up from $95 million a day earlier, as five-session withdrawals reached $1.44 billion. BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF), the iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT), recorded more than $2 billion in net outflows over nine consecutive trading sessions through Wednesday. Investors pulled a net $269.7 million from IBIT on Wednesday, accounting for about 90% of the day’s $300 million in net withdrawals across US spot Bitcoin ETFs, according to Farside Investors data. Grayscale’s Bitcoin Trust ETF (GBTC) recorded $39.1 million in net withdrawals, while the Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust ETF (MSBT) drew $9 million in net inflows. US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted nearly $1.44 billion in net withdrawals over five straight sessions. Wednesday’s increase followed three sessions of easing outflows. Crypto exchange Bitfinex said on Wednesday that slowing ETF outflows could be an early step toward a market floor, but were not enough on their own to establish a recovery. Bitfinex found that in the ETF outflow streaks it studied earlier this year, Bitcoin gained a median 6.4% over 10 trading sessions when the streaks ended with at least three consecutive sessions of net inflows. Bitcoin traded near $73,000 at the time of writing, down 8.5% over the past week, according to CoinGecko. In a Wednesday note shared with Cointelegraph, Laser Digital’s derivatives trading desk pointed to weak spot demand, a persistently negative Coinbase premium and large liquidations of leveraged long positions. The desk said Bitcoin barely rose during Monday’s rebound in the Nasdaq, which gained almost 3%. Related: Bitcoin hovers near $74K as stocks rise despite US bond yield rebound

news.titleTr: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning
news.summaryTr: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.
news.articleText: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning - Published Ugandan police are investigating the deaths of four pupils at a school in the capital Kampala which they suspect may be the result of poisoning. The four girls, aged between nine and 11 years, died on Tuesday. Three of the pupils died at home while the fourth passed away while receiving emergency treatment at a hospital. The head teacher at the school, Ta'aliim Primary School and Quran Memorisation Centre, has been arrested to assist with investigations. According to the school, eight pupils had eaten oranges shared by a fellow pupil. Five pupils, including the four who later died, started vomiting. The fifth is still in hospital. Post-mortem examinations are being carried out to determine the exact cause of death. A police spokesperson was quoted by local media as saying that detectives would visit the village where the oranges the pupils ate came from. The centre has been cordoned off as a crime scene. Ugandan media shared videos of grieving parents describing their children's final moments, with some accusing the school of failing to provide clear and timely information. The police have offered condolences to the bereaved families and affected community and say more information will be provided in due course. The tragedy comes at a time when concerns are mounting over health and safety conditions in schools across Uganda. Previous cases involving suspected contaminated food and exposure to harmful substances have left pupils hospitalised with symptoms including stomach pain, vomiting and breathing difficulties. The incidents have intensified calls for authorities to strengthen monitoring of school feeding schemes, improve hygiene standards and ensure safer learning environments for children. news.articleTextTr: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning - Published Ugandan police are investigating the deaths of four pupils at a school in the capital Kampala which they suspect may be the result of poisoning. The four girls, aged between nine and 11 years, died on Tuesday. Three of the pupils died at home while the fourth passed away while receiving emergency treatment at a hospital. The head teacher at the school, Ta'aliim Primary School and Quran Memorisation Centre, has been arrested to assist with investigations. According to the school, eight pupils had eaten oranges shared by a fellow pupil. Five pupils, including the four who later died, started vomiting. The fifth is still in hospital. Post-mortem examinations are being carried out to determine the exact cause of death. A police spokesperson was quoted by local media as saying that detectives would visit the village where the oranges the pupils ate came from. The centre has been cordoned off as a crime scene. Ugandan media shared videos of grieving parents describing their children's final moments, with some accusing the school of failing to provide clear and timely information. The police have offered condolences to the bereaved families and affected community and say more information will be provided in due course. The tragedy comes at a time when concerns are mounting over health and safety conditions in schools across Uganda. Previous cases involving suspected contaminated food and exposure to harmful substances have left pupils hospitalised with symptoms including stomach pain, vomiting and breathing difficulties. The incidents have intensified calls for authorities to strengthen monitoring of school feeding schemes, improve hygiene standards and ensure safer learning environments for children. news.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
news.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, Binance’s chief security officer described a fake job interview attack months before hackers used a similar tactic in the exchange’s $6.3 billion breach; OKX and NYSE parent ICE prepared to launch tokenized stock trading despite objections from dozens of major companies, and Barclays increased its holdings in BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin ETF by 48% in the third quarter. Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack Months before Binance lost $6.3 billion to a hack, its chief security officer described to Cointelegraph how a fake job interview could give attackers a foothold inside the exchange — closely resembling one of the entry methods later used against the exchange. During a July interview about Binance’s response to rising security threats, Jimmy Su told Cointelegraph that fake job interviews were “something we worry about a lot internally,” explaining how attackers could tailor a job opportunity to an employee before persuading them to run code as part of a technical assessment. “And once that gets executed, the device is compromised and then they can start harvesting credentials,” Su said, adding that attackers could then use that to penetrate further into the network. Su’s detailed warning about malicious coding assessments was not included in Cointelegraph’s July coverage, but takes on new significance following the biggest crypto exchange hack in history. OKXICE moves ahead with tokenized stocks as blue chips push back Crypto exchange OKX and New York Stock Exchange parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) are set to launch tokenized stock trading on Nov. 23, despite objections from 67 companies to having their shares listed and warnings from Nasdaq that trading across disconnected platforms could fragment liquidity. The venture, known as OKXICE, will operate under the US Securities and Exchange Commission’s temporary Innovation Exemption and offer eligible US customers round-the-clock trading. Under the exemption, venues must give companies a chance to object before listing shares tokenized by an unaffiliated third party. JPMorgan Chase, McDonald’s, SpaceX and Coca-Cola were among the companies that objected. Tokenized stocks are blockchain-based tokens that represent company shares or track their price. The rights they carry depend on how they are structured. The distributed value of tokenized stocks and ETFs reached $3.88 billion on Nov. 11, up 13.4% over 30 days. In comments to Cointelegraph, former New York governor and OKXICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo said investors would have “the same rights, protections and ownership that come with the underlying shares.” Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings Barclays reported holding 3.94 million shares in BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF) at the end of the third quarter, up 48% from the previous quarter. The position in the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) was worth about $187 million on Sept. 30, up from $88.5 million for 2.66 million shares on June 30, according to Barclays’ Friday Form 13F filing. “Early readings suggest longer-term holders make up a growing share of the spot bitcoin ETF investor base,” Bitwise analyst Camran Khosravi told Cointelegraph, pointing to increased bank exposure, including at Citigroup. Citigroup reported a new position worth about $119 million in the Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC). Its reported IBIT holdings also rose 50% to about 521,000 shares, from 347,000 at the end of June. The filings offer an early indication of changing institutional Bitcoin ETF ownership, with more major banks and hedge funds yet to disclose their third-quarter positions. Institutional investment managers have until Monday to file their third-quarter holdings reports.

news.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

news.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

news.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

items.summaryTr: TCMB'nin Uluslararası Rezervler ve Döviz Likiditesi Gelişmeleri verilerine göre, resmi rezerv varlıkları geçen ay sonuna kıyasla yüzde 1,9 artarak 161,1 milyar dolar düzeyinde gerçekleşti.
items.articleText: 3 haftadır düşüyordu: Merkez Bankası toplam brüt rezervleri yükseldi YAYIN TARİHİ, 12 Kasım 2026 14:34 PAYLAŞ - TCMB'nin Uluslararası Rezervler ve Döviz Likiditesi Gelişmeleri verilerine göre, resmi rezerv varlıkları geçen ay sonuna kıyasla yüzde 1,9 artarak 161,1 milyar dolar düzeyinde gerçekleşti. Türkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankası'nın (TCMB) toplam brüt rezervleri, üç haftalık düşüşün ardından yükseldi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 6 Kasım haftasında altın rezervleri 104 milyar 40,6 milyon dolara, döviz rezervleri ise 57 milyar 22,8 milyon dolara çıktı. Swap hariç net rezervler de 24,28 milyar dolardan 27,44 milyar dolara yükseldi. TCMB, haftalık para ve banka istatistiklerini açıkladı. Buna göre, TCMB'nin altın rezervleri 102 milyar 16,8 milyon dolardan 104 milyar 40,6 milyon dolara yükseldi. Döviz rezervleri ise 56 milyar 90,2 milyon dolardan 57 milyar 22,8 milyon dolara çıktı. Aynı haftada swap hariç net rezervler 24,28 milyar dolardan 27,44 milyar dolara yükseldi. Kaynak: cnbce.com

items.title: New York building collapse kills at least two, officials say
items.summary: A dangerous search for survivors continues after a three-storey building collapsed in Brooklyn on Wednesday afternoon.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: New York building collapse kills at least two, officials say
items.summaryTr: A dangerous search for survivors continues after a three-storey building collapsed in Brooklyn on Wednesday afternoon.
items.articleText: New York building collapse kills at least two, officials say - Published At least two people have died and more than 17 others are injured after a building in New York City collapsed into an open construction site, officials have said. The collapse sparked a massive search-and-rescue operation, with more than 250 first responders going to the scene of the fallen three-storey building in Brooklyn. Aerial footage has shown firefighters pulling a survivor, covered in dust, out of the debris on a stretcher. She was later said to have been a pregnant woman. US media reports suggest the death toll is rising and officials say they do not know how many others are missing. An investigation is under way into what caused Wednesday afternoon's sudden collapse. Witnesses described a terrifying sound as the building came down at about 16:00 local time (21:00 GMT). "I live literally right behind the building," one woman, Emmanuella Carilus, told the New York Times. "It sounded like a big boom and you just heard a bunch of screaming." The newspaper published images showing a crowd of fire trucks and police vehicles at the same, and wrote that the noise of sirens had not stopped in the area. "I've never seen anything like this," said another witness, named only as Dashik, who spoke to local television station PIX 11. Officials are yet to identify those who died or were injured. Locals have gathered at the scene to await news of those feared to have been caught in the collapse. The rescue mission has been described as "extremely dangerous" by New York City Fire Department (FDNY) Commissioner Lillian Bonsignore. She added that people from the collapsed building and also the construction site had been trapped. "Members have been working methodically and haven't stopped since they arrived this afternoon," Bonsignore said. The woman who was filmed being rescued from the rubble was identified by her husband. Speaking to a reporter from CBS News New York, he described his relief after an anxious wait: "She is alive. She is still alive. I'm very happy. I'm very happy. I'm very happy. I thank all of you guys. She's pregnant, six months." Rescuers have used search dogs, drones, axes and chainsaws to carry out their work. They say they anticipate the effort will last for several days. Some pictures of the collapsed building, on Flatbush Avenue in Brooklyn, show an entire side of it gone, with bedrooms and closets exposed. Among the debris, smashed concrete and twisted metal, are household items and clothes. New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani joined emergency responders at the scene, praising them for their rapid response. They "arrived in under a minute and have spent hours working in dangerous and highly technical conditions to rescue New Yorkers," he later wrote on X. The Brooklyn building was built in 1930, city records show, according to CBS, the BBC's US partner. At the adjacent construction site, where plans have been approved for a new building, active work was going on when the incident occurred, according to FDNY Chief of Department John Esposito. The activity was described by another official as "excavation work". It was not immediately clear whether the work had anything to do with the collapse of the neighbouring building.
